tei:div.tei:p: ngadagye༅/tshong rwa'i ngapal 'byor smor gyi she sa thobya 7ne)rdzo1 7 rte / — /nga / 7 ༷༷༷rdo /deci ༅ ༅ 0 dang/'a ris bsod nams tshe ring gis brtsams gan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagale'u dang po/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor/ (1)dang po/ ci zhig la tshong ra zer (1 )gnyis pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor/ (2)gsum pa/ tshong ra'i ma lag grub tshul/ (3)bzhi ba/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin/(5)lnga ba/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'gran rtsod rang bzhin/ (8)drug pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khrims lugs rang bstunon/ (10)bdun pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi sgo 'byed rang bzhin/(12)brgyad pa/ tshong zog dpal 'byor/ (15)dgu ba/ spyi khog snyom sgrig ( 19)1

bcu ba/ rgyal dmangs yongs 'bab (26)bcu gcig pa/ dngul lor/ (31)bcu gnyis pa/ dngul lor gyi nus pa/ (36)bcu gsum pa/ dpya khral gyi yong 'bab/ (42)bcu bzhi ba/ rin thang chos nyid/ (47)bco lnga ba/ thon las chen po gsum/ (49)le'u gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs/ (53)dang po/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la ngo sprod/ (53)gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzigs kyi grub tshul/(59)gsum pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig lam/ (62)bzhi ba/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim/ (65)lnga ba/ krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i longs spyod khe dbang / (72)2

drug pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyal spyi'i rgyun drosal/ (76)bdun pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyun sdod sku tshab chotshogs pa/ (79)brgyad pa/ krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ (871)dgu ba/ krung go rgyal khab kyis 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang 'khur dgos pa'i 'os 'gan/ (86)bcu ba/ dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab/ (90)le'u gsum pa/ phyi rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong dang bslab bya/(93)dang po/ phyi rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (9 3)gcig a ri nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las 3

thob pa'i nyams myong / (94)gnyis/ ljar pan nas pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (113)gsum/ hi rdu rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (120)bzhi/ hpha ran se rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (125)lnga/ hphin lan rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (127)drug dbyi tha li rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (128)bdun/ the go rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (129)brgyad/ dbyi si ral rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (130)4

dgu/ mo zhi kho rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong / (13/)gnyis pa/ phyi'i rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i bslab bya/ (/ 33)gcig thon khungs dang skye khams khor yug srung skyob la mthong chung byas/ (/33)gnyis/ rjes lus sa khul gyis rang steng 'phel shugs skyed sring la mthong chung byas/ (136)gsum/ srol rgyun rig gnas la mthong chung byas/ (/3 ))bzhi/ thon khungs la rag las che ba'i bzo las spel ba las thon las bar cha 'grig pa'i ngang 'phel rgyas byung bar mthong chung byas/ (1 /0)lnga/ spyi tshogs phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas su gtong bar mthong chung byas/ (1‘/2)

le'u dang po/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor/dang po/ ci zhig la tshong ra zer/tshong ra zer ba ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i brgyud rim nang tshong zog dpal 'byor dang mnyam du 'phel rgyas byung ba dang tshong zog dpal 'byor gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i dpal 'byor rig pa'i tha snyad cig yin/der go don dog pa'i tshong ra dang go don rgya che ba'i tshong ra zhes gnyis yod/ go don dog pa'i tshong ra ni tshong zog nyo tshong ngam brje res byed gnas de yin/ der gzugs ldan gyi tshong ra yang zer/ go don rgya che ba'i tshong ra ni tshong zog gi rgyun 'khor khyab khongs hril bor ston pa dang / der gzugs ldan gyi tshong ra dang gzugs med kyi tshong ra zhes dbye ba red/spyir btang du tshong ra zer ba der 'dzad spyod tshong zog dang thon skyed rgyu cha/ ngal rtsol lus shugs/ ma dngul/ sa khang bdag khongs sogs thad kyi brje res bya 'gul mang po 'dus 1

shing tshong zog rgyun 'khor dang dngos rdzas rgyun 'khor sogs phyogs mang po'i rgyun 'khor bya 'gul 'dus yod/ tshong ra de tshong zog thon skyed dang tshong zog brje res kyi khyab khongs yongs su khyab 'dug pa dang phyogs so so'i dpal 'byor la 'brel ba dam po chags shing spyi tshog/sa dpal 'byor gyi khe pan sna tshogs pa de tshong ra me long lta bu'i ngor lhang nger gsal bzhin 'dug de'i phyir deng rabs kyi tshong ra ni tshong zog thams cad phan tshun brje res dang tshong zog rgyun 'khor gyi spyi bsdoms yin la spyi tshogs tshong zog brje res byed pa'i 'brel ba ci rigs kyi spyi bsdoms kyang yin/gnyis pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor zer ba ni rin thang chos nyid de tshong ra'i mkho sprod che chung gis rin gong yar mar spor ba'i rnam par brten nas spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'khor rgyug la rang shugs kyis snyom sgrig btang ste thon skyed rgyu cha tshad mthun gyi sgo nas sde khag so sor bgo bsha' rgyag bzhin pa'i dpal 2

'byor gyi rnam par ston pa red/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor de don la tshong zog dpal 'byor yin pas tshong zog dpal 'byor dang tshong zog brje res yod pa'i sa gnas su tshong ra dang mkho sprod/ rin thang chos nyid sogs dang kha 'bral mi rung /spyi tshogs khor yug chen po'i nang du tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gnas pa'i cha rkyen gnyis yod de/ gcig ni spyi tshogs kyi las bgos dang / gnyis ni thon skyed rgyu cha dang thon rdzas de dbang 'dzin mkhan mi 'dra bar dbang bas so tshong ra'i dpal 'byor de ni spyi tshogs can gyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor yin pa dang / tshong ra des thon khungs bkod sgrig byed pa'i brgyud rim nang du rmang gzhi rang bzhin gyi nus pa thon thub pa'i dpal 'byor yin/gsum pa/ tshong ra'i ma lag grub tshul/tshong ra'i ma lag zer ba ni phyogs sne mang po 'dzoms pa'i tshong ra'i grub tshul dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i tshong ra'i nang 3

rkyen gnyis ga'i gcig 'du'i phung po lta bu red/ tshong ra'i ma lag de chags grub byung ba'i rmang gzhi ni tshong ra'i rkang 'dzin grub cha rnams la rang nyid so sor kher rkyang gi dpal 'byor khe phan dang 'dra mnyam gyi dpal 'byor thob thang 'dra mnyam 'gran rtsod kyi go skabs/ rang mos kyi rin mnyam brje res byed dbang sogs yin/ tshong ra'i ma lag des tshong ra'i dpal 'byor nang gal 'gangs che ba'i go gnas zin zhing nus pa chen po 'don bzhin yod/tshong ra'i ma lag gi grub tshul de ci 'dra zhig red zer na/dang po ni tshong zog tshong ra yin/ der spyir btang gi tshong zog tshong ra dang khyad par can gyi tshong zog tshong ra zhes sna ga gnyis yod/ spyir btang gi tshong zog tshong ra de yang 'dzad spyod tshong rdzas tshong ra dang thon skyed rgyu cha'i tshong ra las grub pa red/ khyad par can gyi tshong zog tshong ra der sa khang bdag khongs kyi tshong ra/ lag rtsal tshong ra/ cha 'phrin tshong ra/rgyu nor bdag dbang gi tshong ra sogs 'dus yod/ gnyis pa ni ngal rtsol pa'i tshong ra yin la der ched las yon tan tshong 4

ra dang ngal rtsol pa'i tshong ra dkyus ma/ ngal rtsol las zhugs kyi skyed sring dang blo 'dri/ zhabs 'degs sogs kyi tshong ra 'dus yod/ gsum ni dngul rtsa'i tshong ra yin la der dngul lor tshong ra ste dper na dngul 'dzin tshong ra dang dngul lor tshong ra sogs dang / de min da dung phyi rgyal dngul lor tshong ra/ gser gyi tshong ra bcas 'dus yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'khor skyod byed pa'i cha nas bshad na/ tshong ra'i ma lag de da dung rin gong ma lag dang 'brel ba chen po yod/spyir tshong ra'i ma lag gi grub tshul la rnyog 'dzing che na'ang gong smos kyi grub cha mtha' dag la gzhigs te tshong zog gi ngo bo dang brje res/ 'khor rgyug sogs kyi gnas tshul dngos la brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug yag po byas na de ni thag mi chod pa'i gnad don zhig ye nas min/bzhi ba/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin ni tshong 5

ra nas dpal 'byor byed sgor zhugs mkhan bar gyi 'brel ba 'dra mnyam yin par bstan pa red/ 'dra mnyam rang bzhin zer ba ni dpal 'byor gyi rin thang chos nyid la rag las shing rin thang chos nyid kyi nus pa brgyud nas thag gcod byas pa red/ rin thang chos nyid ni tshong zog dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid yin la tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi chos nyid kyang yin/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi las la zhugs ma/khan bar gyi 'brel ba 'dra mnyam yong thub min gyi gnad 'gag gtso bo ni rin mnyam brje res bya rgyu de yin/ rin mnyam brje res kyi rtsa ba'i rtsa don des tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'a sa la zhugs mkhan bar 'dra mnyam gyi 'brel ba chags par thag gcod byas yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin gyis brje res byed mkhan tsho'i spyi tshogs go gnas la khyad par ci yang med pa'i rtsa don de mtshon pa dang / tshong ra'i dpa la 'byor la zhugs mkhan tshang ma thob thang 'dra mnyam gyi 'tshong maXn dang nyo mkhan yin par ma zad/ tshong zog gam dngul

lor dbang 'dzin byed mkhan kyang yin phyir/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin la da dung tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi las la zhugs mkhan su dang su yin na yang des nges par du rin mnyam brje res kyi rtsa don la brtsi srung byed pa las mi su yin yang gzhan gyi ngal rtsol 'bras bu de btsan shed kyis bed spyod bya mi rung zhes pa'i don snying ldan pa red/ rin mnyam brje res ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin mtshon pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin la/rin mnyam brje res kyi cha rkyen kho na las da gzod tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'dra mnyam rang bzhin de mngon 'gyur byed thub/ de yang 'dra mnyam rang bzhin ni spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khyad chos shig yin la tshong ra'i dpal 'byor de go rim mi ldan pa las ldan par 'gyur ba'i ma/thun rkyen gtso bo zhig kyang yin/ ga'/ srid 'dra mnyam rang ba'in la khas ma blangs na tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'khor skyod rgyun ldan yong mi thub/7

lnga ba/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'gran rtsod rang bzhin/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'gran rtsod rang bzhin ni dpal 'byor byed sgor zhugs mkhan phan tshun bar 'gran rtsod kyi khyab rgya che ba der ston pa red/ 'gran rtsod ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi rnam pa ldog med cig yin la tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khyad chos kyang red/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor khrod rdu tshong zog gi tshong ra'i rin gong ni 'gran rtsod las chags grub byung ba zhig red/ de'i phyir 'gran rtsod ni tshong zog brje res byed pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/ 'gran rtsod des tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan dang las gnyer byed mkhan la phyi phyogs kyi gnon shugs skyed pas/ kho tshos rgyun chad med par lag rtsal dang ngal rtsol thon skyed kyi las chod mthor 'degs byed par skul ma btang ste drag rgyal zhan pham gyi lam srol btod/ tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod 'dang nges shig gis rin gong 'phar chag la tshor shes myur bas tshong ra'i mkho 8

sprod kyi 'brel ba la mgyogs por legs sgrig byed thub pa dang / thon khungs bkod sgrig legs por yong rgyur skul 'ded gtong thub/ de'i phyir 'gran rtsod ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'khor skyod dngos dang kha 'bral mi rung / 'gran rtsod kyi khyab khongs su chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs/rig gnas bcas khag bzhi 'dus yod/ khag de dag gi 'gran rtsod la rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang chos nyid ldan zhing nang sgos su dpal 'byor ni mi'i rigs spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rmang gzhi yin phyin dpal 'byor khyab khongs nang gi 'gran rtsod la thag gcod rang bzhin gyi shugs rkyen thebs kyin yod/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la mtshon na 'gran rtsod ni tshong zog dpal 'byor gyi dus rim mthon po'i nang 'bur thon zhing tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi ldog med rang bzhin red/'gran rtsod dar spel dang srung skyob byed pa ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thabs lam 'gangs chen zhig yin/ 'on kyang tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod ni go rim ldan pa'i dpal 'byor gyi bya spyod cig yin pas/ khrims ldan dang 9

lugs mthun gyi sgo nas 'gran rtsod ma byas na/ 'gran rtsod 'a/ skyon mang po dang rjes 'bras ngan pa 'byung nges/ dper na mun 'thom gyis 'gran rtsod byas na spyi tshogs kyi thon khungs 'phro brlag tu gtong srid pa dang thon khungs legs sgrig byed par phan pa med/ de'i phyir spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og thon skyed byed mkhan dang las gnyer byed mkhan gyis kyang 'dra mnyam 'gran rtsod kyi rtsa don la nan gyis brtsi srung byed dgos/drug pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khrims lugs rang ba'in/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khrims lugs rang bzhin ni spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'khor skyod byed pa la 'thus slo tshang ba'i khrims lugs rmang gzhi yod pa dang thon skyed byed mkhan dang las gnyer byed mkhan gyi dpal 'byor bya 'gul de nges par du tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khrims lugs ltar spel dgos pa la zer/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'brel ba bzang bo zhig 10

'dzugs rgyu na/ nges par du khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa dang / khrims lugs kyi tshad ldan rang bzhin dang btsan shed rang bzhin/ gcig gyur rang bzhin/ brtan brling rang bzhin bcas kyi nus pa spyad de tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi rgyun ldan 'khor skyod la khag theg byed pa dang khrims lugs la brten nas dpal 'byor 'brel ba de tshad ldan du gtong ba dang snyom sgrig byas te spyi tshogs thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas su gtong bar skul 'ded byed dgos/ 'dra mnyam 'gran rtsod srung skyong byed ched nges par du dpal 'byor khrims lugs la 'gan len gang legs byed dgos/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel tshad ci 'dra mtho na dpal 'byor khrims lugs de tsam gyis 'thus tshang yin dgos/ de'i phyir tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og dpal 'byor bya 'gul la zhugs mkhan tshang mas nges par du khrims lugs kyi rig gzhung la slob sbyong dang khrims shes pa/khrims srung ba/ khrims bed spyod pa bcas byas te gcig nas rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor gyi bya ba sgrib srol khrims lugs dang 11

mthun pa dang / gnyis nas khrims lugs bed spyad de rang nyid kyi khe phan srung skyob gang legs byed dgos/bdun pa/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi sgo 'byed rang bzhin/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi sgo 'byed rang bzhin ni tshong ra phan tshun 'brel yod pa'i khar rgyal yongs ni gcig gyur gyi tshong ra chen po zhig yin par ma zad 'dzam gling gi tshong ra chen po dang yang 'brel yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor ni tshong ra rmang gzhi byas te thon khungs bkod sgrig byed bzhin pa'i dpal 'byor yin pas/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gong du spel dgos na/ rgyal khab nang gi thon khungs dang tshong ra kho nar brten mi chog kyang nges par du rgyal khab phyi nang gnyis sha'i thon khungs dang tshong ra gsar spel dang bed spyod byed dgos/ nang sgos su rgyal khab nang bi thon khungs bkod sgrig gang legs byed pa dang / rgyal khab phyi'i thon khungs de bed spyod byed gang thub byed dgos/ deng 12

rabs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba de rgyal khab gcig gi sa khongs su bsgrub thub pa zhig ma yin pas/ tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan gyis 'dzam gling gi tshong ra chen por kha gtad dgos par ma zad/ 'dzam gling tshong ra chen po'i 'gran rtsod nang du'ang 'jug dgos pa red/ gal srid nga tsho gzhan gyi tshong rar ma zhugs na/ gzhan gyis kyang nga tsho'i tshong rar 'dzul ba smos ma dgos/ der brten tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og thon skyed byed mkhan dang las gnyer byed mkhan gyis tshong ra'i dgos mkhor gzhigs te thon skyed dang las gnyer byed dgos/ de yang don la 'dzad spyod pa gang sar gnas yod na/ tshong zog kyang phyogs der rang shugs kyis 'khor rgyug byed nges yin/ spyi tshogs kyi las bgos dang thon skyed ched las can 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba'i dbang gis tshong ra gsar spel dang sgo 'byed rang bzhin ldan dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/ dus mtshungs su gu dog gi sa khongs bkag bsdoms las grol na thon skyed kyi ma rgyu de rang mos kyis 13

'khor rgyug byed thub pa dang dpal 'byor gyi bya 'gul la zhugs mkhan rnams kyis gzhi nas rang nyid kyis khyad 'phags nus pa 'don spel gang legs byed pa dang chabs cig gzhan gyi phul byung thon skyed dang tshan rtsal 'bras bu bed spyod byed gang thub byas te thon khungs bkod sgrig legs por byed pa'i dmigs yul bsgrub thub/ krung go rgyal khab ni 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab cig yin pas nges par du rang gi rgyal khab kyi dngos yod gnas tshul te rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs dang mi dmangs kyi phyogs bsdus byang tshad/ srid 'byor rig gsum gyi 'phel tshad sogs la gzhigs te phyi phyogs la sgo mo 'byed pa las rang gi gnas tshul dngos la ma bltas par mun 'thom ngang phyi phyogs su sgo phye ba zhig ye nas min/ las rigs kyi cha nas bshad na tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi khyab khongs su zhing las dang bzo las//rlangs 'khor/ rno lcags/ bde srung / zhor tshong sogs 'dus/krung go'i las rigs so so'i 'phel tshad mi gcig la/ rma/nga gzhi yang kha kha yin pas phyi phyogs la sgo mo 'byed pa'i cha rkyen 14

dang mgyogs tshad kyang mi gcigabargyad pa/ tshong zog dpal 'byor/tshong zog yin na nges par du ngal rtsol las grub pa'i thon rdzas yin dgos pas/ ngal rtsol las grub pa ma yin pa'i thon rdzas dper na sa chu me rlung dang ri brag nags gsum/mtha' yas rtswa thang / tha na mkha' dbugs dang nyi 'od sogs lta bu/ don la mi'i rigs kyi shes rig dang ngal rtsol gyis bzo bkod ma byas pa'i rang byung skye dngos mtha' dag tshong zog min/ ngal rtsol thon rdzas yin kyang gal srid brje res ma byas na tshong zog tu gyur mi srid/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/tshong zog ni thon skyed byed mkhan rang nyid kyis 'dzad spyod byed pa'i ched du bzo skrun byed pa zhig min 'a// de las ldog ste mi gzhan dang spyi tshogs kyis 'dzad spyod byed rgyur 'don sprod dang brje res byas pa brgyud de mi gzhan gyi lag tu sprad pa de red/ mar khe si'i gsung don la thon rdzas gzhan pa dang brje res byed thub pa'i thon rdzas yin na tshong zog yin da

zhes pa'i dgongs don la gzhigs na tshong zog ni nges par du brje res byed dgos pa'i ngal rtsol thon rdzas shig yin dgos/de yang ngal rtsol thon rdzas de tshong zog tu bsgyur dgos na/dang thog nges par du mi rnams kyis bed spyod byed thub la mi tsho'i dgos mkho skong thub pa'i thon rdzas shig yin dgos/tshong zog rigs so so'i rang byung gi ngo bo mi gcig pa'i dbang gis/ de dag gi bkol sa dang phan nus kyang mi gcig dper na sring bal las bzos pa'i gos kyis grang ngar 'bog pa dang / zas rigs kyis ltogs skom sel ba/ dpe deb kyis lta klog gi 'dod pa skong ba/ smyug gu yis yi ge 'bri ba/dkar me yis mun nag sel ba sogs lta bu red/ der brten dpal 'byor rig pa las tshong zog gis mi rnams kyi dgos mkho ci yang skong thub pa'i ngo bo der tshong zog gi bkol spyod rin thang zer/ tshong zog yin na nges par du bkol spyod kyi rin thang ldan dgos/ gal te bkol spyod kyi rin thang med na mi la dgos pa med/ de'i phyir tshong zog gi bkol spyod rin thang de tshong zog dpal 'byor gyi lte ba'i grub cha zhig tu gyur 16

yod/ yin na yang tshong zog ni gna' dang po nas yod pa zhig min la/ mi'i rigs kyis gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi yun ha cang ring ba'i nang du mnyam du ngal rtsol byas pa dang / thon rdzas 'dra mnyam ngang bgo bsha' rgyag pa/ thon rdzas tshang ma rang nyid kyis 'dzad spyod byas tshar bas mi gzhan dang brje res byed rgyu med/ 'on kyang thon skyed nus shugs mthor 'degs dang 'phel rgyas su song bar bstun spyi tshogs la rim gyis las babos kyi snang tshul gsar ba byung ba dang / thog mar zhing las dang phyugs las kha bkar nas thon rdzas lhag ma byung bar ma zad/ skabs 'gar da dung brje res byed rgyu'ang yod/ der brten spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la tshong zog dang tshong zog brje res kyi rnam pa gsar ba de byung ba red/gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi dus mjug la bslebs dus thon skyed nus shugs sngar las lhag par 'phel rgyas su phyin nas lag shes bzo las de zhing las nas kha bkar ba'i spyi tshogs kyi las bgos chen po zhig byung ba dang / thon rdzas lhag ma de bas je mang du song nas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyang 17

tshugs/ der brten spyi tshogs su brje res byed par dmigs nas thon skyed byed pa ste tshong zog thon skyed zer ba byung /tshong zog thon skyed ni tshong zog brje res kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pas/ tshong zog thon skyed de tshong zog brje res dang gtan nas kha 'bral mi rung / gal te thon skyed byas pa'i tshong zog dag brje res byed ma thub na tshong zog thon skyed de mu mthud du yar rgyas gong 'phel la 'gro mi thub/ de'i phyir tshong zog thon skyed dang tshong zog brje res gnyis ma'i spyi ming la tshong zog dpal 'byor zer/ tshong zog dpal 'byor yin pas nges par du cha rkyen 'di gnyis 'dzom dgos te/gcig ni spyi tshogs kyi las babos dang / gnyis ni thon skyed rgyu cha dang thon rdzas de dbang mkhan mi 'dra bar dbang bas so/ /spyi tshogs kyi las babos ni tshong zog dpal 'byor chags grub dang 'phel rgyas yong ba'i rmang gzhi sha stag yin/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su tshong zog dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas chen po byung nas spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi khrod du do zla med pa'i bo gnas zin zhing ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshong zog 18

dpal 'byor gyi gzhi chags/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs la mtshon na'ang tshong zog dpal 'byor yod mod/'on kyang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor de spyi la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i thog gsar thon gyi tshong zog dpal 'byor zhig red/ spyir tshong zog dpal 'byor la tshong zog dpal 'byor chung ngu dang ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor bcas rigs gsum dbye rgyu yod/dgu ba/ spyi khog snyom sgrigaspyi khog snyom sgrig zer ba ni dpal 'byor 'khor skyod kyi khyon yongs la dmigs te rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor spyi'i 'khor skyod brgyud rim la 'char 'god ldan pa'i ngang snyom sgrig dang tshod 'dzin byed pa de red/ spyi khog snyom sgrig la srid gzhung rang bzhin gyi nus pa ldan pa dang / de ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi nang rkyen yin pas tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar thog mtha' bar gsum du 19

sbrags par ma zad/ tshong ra'i skyon cha rim bzhin phyir mngon pa dang bstun nas rim bzhin shugs snon rgyag dgos pa red/tshong rar gzhi brten nas thon khungs bkod sgrig byed pa ni dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i nus ldan thabs shes shig yin mod/ 'on kyang tshong ras snyom sgrig la skyon cha med pa zhig min te/ der rang steng nas sel thabs med pa'i skyon cha mang po yod pas/ nges par du rgyal khab kyis spyi khog snyo ma sgrig byas nas kha gsab dang yo bsrang byed dgos/ 'o na tshong ras snyom sgrig la skyon cha ga 'dra yod zer na/dang po tshong ras snyom sgrig la dus thung rang bzhin yod/tshong ras snyom sgrig de gtso bo mkho sprod dang rin gong 'gran rtsod sogs tshong ra'i rgyu rkyen dag gi bar phan chun nus pa bton nas mngon 'gyur byung ba yin/ 'gran rtsod la dza drag che zhing rin gong la 'phar chag byung 'dug pas/ 'gran rtsod dang rin gong gnyis ku'i nus pa mnyam thon gyi gnas tshul 'og tu mkho sprod kyi 'brel ba de brtan po zhig min la tshong rar 'gyur ldog cung che/ gsal bor bshad na tshong ras snyom 20

sgrig gis dus yun thung thung nang byung ba'i mkho sprod bar gyi 'gal bar thag gcod byed thub pa las mkho sprod bar yun ring do mnyam yong ba rgyun 'khyongs byed mi thub/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi cha nas bshad na/ spyi tshogs kyi mkho sprod do mnyam yong ba de ni rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor rgyun chad med par gtan 'jags ngang 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i rmang gzhi yin/ 'on kyang tshong ras snyom sgrig la dus thung rang bzhin yod pas mkho sprod do mnyam gyi mu mthud mi thub pa dang /mkho sprod do mnyam byed mi thub pas/ nges par du rgyal khab kyis spyi khog snyom sgrig byed pa brgyud de spyi tshogs kyi mkho sprod 'brel ba dus thog dang rang 'gul gyis snyom sgrig byas nas rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gtan 'jags ngang 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos/gnyis pa tshong ras snyom sgrig la mun 'thom rang bzhin yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og tu tshong rar zhugs mkhan gyis rang gi khe phan kho na gzhir bzung nas mkho sprod kyi jus thag bcad pa yin pas tshong ra'i gnas tshul 21

gsal bor shes med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi bya 'gul la zhugs mkhan tshang ma kha thor nas so so rang yul du gnas te las gnyer byed kyin yod stabs tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan rkyang ba dang las gnyer byed mkhan rkyang ba rnams kyis spyi tshogs kyi phyogs gang thad kyi cha 'phrin med la/ dpal 'byor 'gyur ldog dang 'phel phyogs la tshod 'dzin byed thabs bral bas/ kho tshos tshong ra dang las gnyer thad jus thag bcad pa de nam yang spyi tshogs thon khungs bkod sgrig gi lugs mthun rang bzhin gyi blang bya dang rgyab 'gal byas par ma zad/ mun 'thom gyi rang bzhin kyang ldan pa red/ de yang mi mang po zhig gis phyogs so so nas mun 'thom ngang jus thag bcad pa de lhan du 'dus dus dpal 'byor gyi spyi'i go rim rnog pa dang / spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la dus rgyun 'phar chag dang thon khungs 'phro brlag tu gtong nges yin/ yin na yang srid gzhung gis spyi khog snyom sgrig byas na tshong ra'i skyon cha de dag rtsa ba nas sel thub/gsum pa tshong ras snyom sgrig la khe bzang kho nar dmigs 22

pa'i rang bzhin yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og tu tshong gnyer pas khe spogs chen po kho nar dmigs pas khe yod bya ba sgrub pa las khe med bya ba mi sgrub/ dper na spyi pa'i sgrig chas dang / skye khams khor yug srung skyob sogs khe spogs lon yun dal bas khe las gang zhig gis kyang sgrub mi 'dod/de'i rkyen gyis spyi tshogs thog spyi pa'i thon rdzas kyi mkho sprod mi 'dang zhing skye khams khor yug nyin rer bzhin je sdug red/tha na tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan dang tshong gnyer byed mkhan rnams kyis rang gi khe phan gnyer ba'i ched du lugs mthun min pa'i dpal 'byor bya spyod kyang sgrub nges red/dper na thon rdzas rdzun ma thon skyed dang btsong ba/ mgo skor btang nas tshong ra btsan bzung / tshong ra'i sgrig srol la gtor brlag dang go rim med pa'i ngang 'gran rtsod byas te dngul sgor kho nar bkur ba las spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa'i phyir/ spyi tshogs rim khag so so'i yong sgo'i he bag je che dang / tha na mtha' gnyis su kha gyes te spyi tshogs kyi 'gal zla je drag tu 'gro bar ma zad/ dpal 'byor 23

dang spyi tshogs skyon bral ngang 'phel rgyas su gtong dka'/gal srid srid gzhung gis spyi khog dpal 'byor gyi cha nas snyo ma sgrig gang legs ma byas na/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor de rgyun ma chad par bde blag ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba ni las sla mo min/bzhi ba tshong ras snyom sgrig la rjes lus kyi rang bzhin yod/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor nang du tshong ra snyom sgrig ni bya ba sgrub tshar rjes da gzod snyom sgrig byed rgyu yin pas tshong ra'i go skabs mang por dal 'gor byas par ma zad/ dpal 'byor bya 'gul la zhugs mkhan gyis tshong zog gang rung zhig mkho sprod do mi mnyam par rin gong la 'phar chag byung rjes gzhi nas tshong zog de rigs kyi mkho sprod kyi mang nyung la mnyam 'jog byas nas jus thag bcad pa red/ de bzhin sgrub par brten tshong zog gi mkho sprod do mi mnyam pa rin gong la 'gyur ldog byung ba jus thag bcad pa mkho sprod do mnyam yong ba bcas kyi brgyud rim des dus tshod 'gor zhing go skabs yal ba'i 'gal rkyen bzos/ tshong ras snyom sgrig la 24

rjes lus rang bzhin ldan pas dpal 'byor 'phar chag dang thon khungs 'phro brlag mang po byas pa dang / nang sgos su zhing las dang nags las/ 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs bcas la shugs rkyen gsal bor thebs 'dug der yang srid gzhung gis spyi khog snyom sgrig byas nas skyon cha de rigs sel rogs byas te rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor bde blag ngang 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos/spyir spyi khog snyom sgrig ni dpal 'byor rig pa'i cha nas bshad na/ srid gzhung gis tshong ras snyom sgrig la kha gsab dang de'i skyon cha dag sel dang yo bsrang byed pa'i thabs lam gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ der tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'phel phyogs kyi chibs kha sgyur ba dang tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rim la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nus stobs chen po ldan pas/ de ni deng rabs spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang deng rabs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor la mtshon na dngos gnas med mi rung ba zhig red/25

bcu ba/ rgyal dmangs yong 'bab/rgyal dmangs yong 'bab zer ba ni ngal rtsol pas gsar skrun byas pa'i spyi tshogs kyi rgyu nor la ston pa dang / des kyang rgyal khab cig gis dus nges can zhig gi nang du thon skyed bskyar ma rgya cher gtong ba dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i nus pa mtshon gyin yod/ spyi tshogs thon skyed kyi brgyud rim nang tshan rig lag rtsal gsar ba yongs khyab nas bkol te ngal rtsol thon skyed kyi la/sa chod mthor 'degs byas na/ da gzod phyogs gcig nas thon 'bor 'phar snon 'byung thub la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'dzad gron gang thub kyis je nyung la gtong thub/ rgyal dmangs yong 'bab kyi khongs su don tshan 'di 'dra 'dus yod de/ dang po ni gsog 'jog yin/ gsog 'jog la thon skyed bskyar ma rgya cher gtong ba dang thon skyed rang bzhin ma yin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs kyi dngos rdzas gsog 'jog bcas sna kha gsum 'dus yod/ gnyis pa ni 26

'dzad spyod yin/ 'dzad spyod la spyi pa'i 'dzad spyod dang mi sger gyi 'dzad spyod bcas sna kha gnyis yod pa'i nang spyi pa'i 'dzad spyod la rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin do dam dang rgyal srung /tshan rig dang slob gso/ rig gnas/ 'phrod bsten/ spyi tshosas kyi 'gan len bcas 'dus yod/ spyir bshad na rgyal dmangs yong 'bab de khag gsum las grub pa yin te/gcig ni thon skyed byed pa'i brgyud rim nang zad gron byas pa'i thon skyed rgyu chas kyi rin thang(0)gnyis ni ngal rtsol pa rang gis 'dzad spyod byed pa'i ched du gsar skrun byas pa'i dgos nges thon rdzas kyi rin thang(5)gsum ni ngal rtsol pas spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho bskang ched gsar skrun byas pa'i thon rdzas lhag ma'i rin thang( )bcas yin/ de yang spyi 'gros kyis mtshon na 'di ltar te/ 0 5 don dam par rgyal dmangs kyi yong 'bab de dngos rdzas thon skyed sde khag gi ngal rtsol pa rnams kyis gsar skrun byas pa smos ci dgos/ de yang rgyal dmangs kyi yong 'bab la 'phar snon rgyag thub min de sasham gsal gyi rgyu rkyen gsum la rag las yod/ dang po 27

dngos rdzas thon skyed sde khag nang ngal rtsol 'bor tshad la kha snon rgyag dgos/ gnyis pa ngal rtsol thon skyed las chod mu mthud du mthor 'desas byed dgos/ gsum pa dngos rdzas rgyu chas gron chung byed dgos pa bcas red/rgyal dmangs yong 'bab la bgo bsha' rgyas pa ni spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi yong 'bab babo bsha' rgyag pa'i khongs su gtogs shing der phyogs gnyis kyi nang don ldan pa/ gcig ni gsog 'jog dang gzhan zhig ni 'dzad spyod yin/ rgyal dmangs kyi yong 'bab nang gsos 'jog thad bkol ba'i khag la thon skyed bskyar ma rgya cher gtong ba dang / thon skyed rang bzhin ma yin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs dngos po'i gsog 'jog bcas phyogs gsum gyi nang don 'dus yod/ dper na bzo grwa 'dzugs skrun/ lcags lam 'ding ba/ sa rgod slog pa/ rtswa thang srung skyob/ chu bed gsar bzo sogs mtha' dag thon skyed bskyar ma rgya cher gtong ba bye brag gi mtshon tshul dang thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba/ mi dmangs/ kyi 'tsho 28

ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa sogs kyi rtsa ba'i thabs lam yin par ma zad/ gsog 'jog gi nang don gtso bo'ang yin/ slob grwa dang sman khang / rig gnas khang / dpe mdzod khang / dngos mang bshams sto na khang / lus rtsal khang sogs tshang ra/ thon skyed rang bzhin ma yin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun de yang spyi tshogs thon skyed 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dang /mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par mtshon na dngos su med mi rung ba zhig red/ dmag 'khrug dang rang byung gnod 'tshe sogs glo bur du 'byung ba'i gnas tshul la sngon 'gog byed pa'i ched du dngos rdzas gsog 'jog byed pa de yang spyi tshogs thon skyed brgyud rim la bar chad mi phog pa'i khag theg gtso bo yin/ rgyal dmangs yong 'bab nang 'dzad spyod thad bkol ba'i khag la mi sger gyi 'dzad spyod dang spyi pa/'i 'dzad spyod bcas phyogs gnyis kyi nang don 'dus yod/ mi sger gyi 'dzad spyod de gtso bo ngal rtsol pa rang nyid dang de'i khyim tshang gi 'dzad spyod byed pa la zer/spyi pa'i 'dzad spyod de rgyal khab srid 'dzin do dam dang rgyal 29

srung gi 'gro gron/ tshan rig dang slob gso/ rig gnas/'phrod bsten sogs thad du btang ba'i 'gro gron/ de min da dung spyi tshogs skyob gso dang ngal rtsol nyen 'gog sogs/ thad du btang ba'i 'gro gron sogs la zer/ spyi pa'i 'jad spyod ni spyi tshogs gtan 'jags dang rgyal khab bde 'jags yong ba/ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad ma/thor 'degs gtong ba dang / de min spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed bskyar ma rgyun ldan ngang sgrub par khag theg byed pa bcas kyi dgos nges kyi 'dzad spyod la zer/thon skyed 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dang rgyal dmangs kyi yong 'bab 'phar snon byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng gsog 'jog dang 'dzad spyod byed tshad la 'phar snon rgyag dgos/ gsog 'jog gi dmigs yul ni thon skyed bskyar ma mu ma/thud du rgya je cher gtong ba de yin la/ thon skyed gong 'phel du byung ba de 'dzad spyod kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i rmang gzhi yin/ 'dzad spyod ni thon skyed kyi dmigs yu la yin la/ thon skyed gong 'phel du 'gro bar skul 'ded byed pa'i byed thabs gtso bo'ang yin/ rgyal dmangs yong 'bab bgo batha' rgyag 30

pa'i khrod du nges par du gsog 'jog dang 'dzad spyod bar gyi 'brel ba yang dag pa'i sgo nas thag gcod byed dgos/bcu gcig pa/ dngul lor/dngul lor ni spyir btang gi rin mnyam dngos rdzas byed pa'i tshong zog khyad par can zhig yin la/ tshong zog dang dngul lor gnyis ka nam yang kha 'bral mi rung / lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim la gzhigs na dngul lor byung ba'i dus skabs tshong zog las 'phyi/ dngul lor ni tshong zog brje res byed pa'i brgyud rim nang rang shugs su byung ba dang / tshong zog brje res yun ring bor 'phel rgyas las byung ba'i thon dngos shig yin la/ tshong zog dpal 'byor nang rkyen gyi 'gal ba je drag tu gyur pa las byung ba'i dngos po zhig kyang yin/gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi dus mjug tu tshong zog brje res thog mar byung ba dang / skabs der mi tshos thon rdzas lhag ma brje res byed kyin yod/ dper na lug gnyis rdo bzos sta re gcig la brje ba dang / lug gnyis kyi rin gong de sta re 31

gocig gi rin gong dang 'dra mnyam yin/ lug gi rin thang de rdo bzos sta re las mtshon pa dang / rdo bzos sta re ni lug gi rin thang mtshon byed kyi thabs shig yin/ spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs mu mthud du mthor 'degs dang spyi tshogs kyi las bgos phra zhib tu song bar bstun tshong zog brje res kyi khyab khongs sngar las rgya je che dang / brje res byed chog pa'i tshong zog gi rnam grangs kyang je mang du song bas/ skabs der tshong zog rigs gcig gis tshong zog rigs gzhan mang po brje thub mod/ 'on kyang brje res byed chog pa'i tshong zog gi rigs je mang du song bar bstun tshong zog dang tshong zog brje res byed pa'i bar gyi skyon cha yang lhag tu gsal bo yin/ rgyu mtshan ni tshong zog brje res byed mkhan phyogs gnyis kur phan tshun gyi tshong zog la dgos mkho yod dus gzhi nas brje res byed thub/ de min brje res byed mi thub/ brje res byed thabs de mu mthud du 'phel rgyas byung bar bstun tshong zog dang tshong zog brje res byed pa la dka' khag tsam byung 'dug der brten mi tshos spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong 32

zog cig gis smyan byas nas rang nyid la mkho ba'i tshong zog brje res byed pa red/ mi tshos lo rgyus kyi dus yun ring ba'i nang du brje res thengs mang por byas pa'i nyams myong las ngos zin thob pa ltar/ sa khul gang zhig gi tshong ra'i nang gi tshong zog gang zhig ni mi tshang mas nges par du nyo 'dod pa'i tshong zog cig yin/ de'i phyir mi tshos rang gi lag yod tshong zog de thog mar mi tshang mas nyo 'dod pa'i tshong zog tu brjes/ dper na rang gi sta re de lug la brjes te lug gis kyang rang la mkho ba'i tshong zog gzhan brje ba red/ de yang gsal bor bshad na/ tshong zog brje res byed pa de mu mthud du gong 'phel la song bar brten/ rim gyis tshong zog rigs mang por thun mong gi rin mnyam tshong zog cig byung ba red/thun mong gi rin mnyam tshong zog de rigs la'ang spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog zer/ spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog ni tshong zog gzhan pa'i nang nas kha gyes par ma zad/tshong zog yod tshad dang phan tshun brje res byed thub pa dang gzhan gyi tshong zog yod tshad kyi rin thang mtshon pa'i tshong zog 3 3

cig red/ spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog byung rjes tshong zog brje thabs la sna kha gnyis yod/ gcig ni rang gi tshong zog gis spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog brjes pa dang /gnyis ni spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog gis rang la ma/kho ba'i tshong zog brjes pa red/ spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog de rim gyis tshong zog khyad par ba zhig tu gtan khel byas pa red/ de yang khyad 'phags rang bzhin ldan pa 'i tshong zog de ni gtan khel byas pa'i dngul lor yin/ tshong zos gang zhig gis spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog gi tshab byed thub pa red zer na/ de yang dus dang sa khul mi gcis pa'i dbang gis tshab byed tshong zog gi rigs kyang mi gcis lo rgyus thog phyugs zog dang ras yug 'gron bu/ lpags pa/ de min gse/ra dngul zangs lcags sogs kyis spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog gi tshab byed myong /tshong zog brje res kyi khyab khongs rgya je cher song bar bstun spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog de tshong zog risas gcig gi thog gtan khel byas pa de tshong zog brje res 'phel 34

rgyas su gtong bar phan pa chen po yod/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel ba'i brgyad rim nang spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog de rim gyis ༄gser dngul gnyis kya'i thog tu gcig 'dus byas pa reg de'i rgyu mtshan ni gser dngul la bongs tshad chung zhing rin thang che ba/ 'khyer bde la yun ring nyar tshags byas kyang bdar zad nyung ba/ spus dag cing do mnyam pa/ gtubs nas bgo sla ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pas spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog gi tshab byed 'os/ spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog gi tshab byed du gtan khel btang ba'i gser dngul der dngul lor zer/ mar khe sis gsungs pa ltar gser dngul ni rang grub kyi dngul lor zhig min mod/'on kyang dngul lor ni rang grub kyi gser dngul red ces pa'o/ /dngul lor ni tshong zog gi nang nas kha gyes te spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog tu gtan khel byas pa'i tshong zog cig red/ dngul lor gyi ngo bo ni spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog yin no/ /35

bcu gnyis pa/ dngul lor gyi nus pa/dngul lor ni tshong zog yin pas tshong zog gzhan dag bzhin du bkol spyod rin thang ldan pa dang / dngul lor de yang tshong zog khyad par can yin pas der tshong zog gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos gnyis mchis te/ gcig ni dngul lor gyis spyi tshogs ngal rtsol thad gar mtshon pa dang spyi tshogs rgyu nor gyi tshab byed kyin yod/ de yang dngul lor ma yin pa'i tshong zog gi rin thang de dngul lor dang brje res byed par brgyud nas mtshon pa red/ gnyis ni dngul lor gyi bkol spyod rin thang la mtshon na/ de ni spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog yin pas tshong zog gang yin pa nyo thub/ de yang dngul lor ma yin pa'i tshong zog gi bkol spyod rin thang de rang gi rang grub kyi ngo bor brten te mi tsho'i tshong zog nyo ba'i dgos mkho dang re 'dod bskangs pa red/dngul lor gyi nus pa de dngul lor gyis mi rnams kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i nang du bton pa'i nus pa la zer/36

dngul lor la bsdoms pas nus pa lnga mchis pa las dang po ni dngul lor gyi rin thang tshad gzhi zer ba de yin/ dngul lor gyi rin thang tshad gzhi des tshong zog gzhan dag gi rin thang che chung mtshon pa dang / dngul lor ni tshong zog gi rin thang che chung gi tshad 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi lta bu red/ rgyu mtshan ni dngul lor tshong zog yin par ma zad/ de la'ang rin thang ldan pa red/ dngul lor byung ba nas bzung ste tshong zog gi rin thang che chung de yang dngul lor mang nyung gis mtshon gyin yod/ spyir dngul lor gyis tshong zog gi rin thang mtshon pa der rin gong zer/ rin gong ni rin thang gi dngul lor mtshon pa dang rin thang ni rin gong gi rmang gzhi yin/gnyis pa ni 'khor rgyug byed thabs/ dngul lor byung rjes tshong zog yod mkhan gyis thog mar lag yod tshong zog dngul lor la brjes nas dngul lor gyis kyang rang la mkho ba'i tshong zog ci rigs nyo ba dang / dngul lor de tshong zog brje res byed pa'i smyan byed du gyur yod/ de'i phyir dngul lor gyis smyan byed pa'i tshong zog brje res la 'khor rgyug zer ba dang /37

de'i spyi 'gros ni tshong zogashedangul lor tshong zog dngul lor gyis tshong zog brje res la smyan byed pa'i 'gan nus der 'khor rgyug byed thabs zer/ gong smos kyi dngul lor gyi rin thang tshad gzhi dang dngul lor gyi 'khor rgyug byed thabs gnyis ni dngul lor gyi rtsa ba'i 'gan nus yin/ dngul lor gyi nus pa gsum pa ni nyar tshags byed thabs yin/ dngul lor ni rin mnyam tshong zog yin pas mi tshos de rgyu nor gyi tshab byas te nyar tshags byed kyin yod/ dngul lor spyi tshogs rgyu nor gyi tshab byas nas nyar tshags byed pa der dngul lor gyi nyar tshags byed thabs zer/ nyar tshags byed pa'i dngul lor de don dngos ldan zhing rin thang 'dang thag chod cig yin dgos pas/ gser dngul yin phyin gzhi nas nyar tshags byed pa'i rin thang dang nus pa ldan pa red/ dngul lor gyi nus pa bzhi ba ni gtong sprod byed thabs de red/dngul lor bed spyad de bu lon dang dpya khral 'jal ba gla phogs sprod pa sogs kyi nus pa bton pa der dngul lor gyi gtong sprod byed thabs zer/ dngul lor byung ba nas bzung 38

ste tshong zog nyo skabs lag dngul byin nas nyo ba/ dngul lor gtong sprod byed thabs de mi tshos tshong zog brje res byed pa'i khrod du rin pa chad 'jog byed par bstun nas byung ba yin/rin pa rjes 'jog dang dom nyo byed skabs dngul lor de yang bu lon 'jal byed cig yin/ phyis su rim gyis zhing bogs gtong ba dang / skyed yi khral dngul/ gla phogs sogs sprod byed du gyur/ dngul lor gyi nus pa lnga ba ni 'dzam gling gi dngul lor byed pa de red/ 'dzam gling gi dngul lor zer ba la dngul lor der 'dzam gling tshong ra'i nang du spyir btang gi rin mnyam tshong zog byed pa'i 'gan nus ldan par ston/dngul lor la rgyal khab dang rgyal khab bar dpal 'byor gyi 'brel ba byed skabs gsham gsal gyi nus pa yod/ gcig ni spyir btang gi nyo sgrub byed thabs byas te phyi rgyal gyi tshong zog nyo ba dang / gnyis ni spyir btang gi gtong sprod byed thabs byas te rgyal spyi'i gtong len gyi chad grangs do mnyam byed pa/gsum ni spyi tshogs rgyu nor gyi tshab byas nas rgyal khab gcig nas rgyal khab gzhan zhig la spo ba/ dper na rgyal spyi'i dngul 39

bun/ rgyu nor gnas spo/ dmag 'khrug gsab dngul sogs lta bu'o/ /de yang nga tshos da lta bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i dngul lor de gser dngul la sogs pa/ las grub pa ma yin par shog bu las bzos pa yin pas shog sgor zer/ shog sgor ni rgyal khab kyis 'grem spel byed pa dang btsan shed kyis bkol spyod byed du 'jug pa'i dngul lor gyi mtshon rtags yin/shog sgor de lcags rigs dngul lor dang bsdur na gsham gsal gyi dge mtshan ldan pa ste/ dang po shog sgor dpar skrun byed pa'i ma rtsa lcags rigs dngul lor las nyung / gnyis pa lcags rigs dngul lor de 'khor rgyugs byed pa'i khrod du bdar zad thebs te lcags rigs rtsa chen gyi rin thang shor ba 'gog thub/ gsum/ pa khrims lugs la brtsi srung mi byed pa des lcags rigs dngul lor gtub gzhog byed pa'am lcags rigs dngul lor bzhus pa sogs dngul lor gyi 'khor rgyug la gnod pa skyel ba'i bya spyod 'gog thub/ bzhi ba shog sgor de lcags rigs dngul lor dang bsdur na bdag gnyer dang 10

'khyer sla ba/ skyel 'dren byed bde ba sogs kyi dge mtshan ldan pa red/ 'og sgor gyis lcags rigs dngul 'o ra gyi tshab byas pa nas bzung mi tshos nyo tshong rgyag skabs bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i shog sgor la dngul lor zer/ mi dmangs shog sgor ni rang rgyal gyi khrims lugs dang mthun pa'i dngul lor yin pas/ mi dmangs shog sgor gyi 'grem spel dbang cha de rgyal khab mi dmangs dngul khang la gtogs/ mi dmangs shog sgor gyi 'khor rgyug byed pa de rang rgyal gyi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba rgyun 'khyodas dang 'phel rgyas su satong ba'i srog rtsa lta bu yin la/ mi dmangs shog sgor de nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba dam po yod pas mi dmangs shog sgor la gces skyong byed pa ni spyi dmangs tshang mar bshad ma dgos pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin phyin/ mi dmangs shos sgor gtsang ma dang cha tshang ba zhig byed dgos pa las mi dmangs shog sgor thog ri mo gang byung du 'bri ba dang shog sgor lteb pa/ gshag pa/ brlag pa sogs gtan nas bya mi rung /41

bcu gsum pa/ dpya khral gyi yong 'bab/rgyal khab kyi nor srid yong 'bab mang che ba ni dpya khral bsdu ba las byung ba red/ de'i nang don ni rgyal khab kyis bca' khrims nang gtan lel byas pa'i tshad gzhi ltar dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyi lag nas dngul lor dang dngos po bsdu len byed pa la zer/ khral sdud bca' khrims ni dpya khral khrims lugs kyi gzhi 'dzin sa dang khrims lugs kyi 'gan len zhig yin zhing / dpya khral yod pa'i spyi tshogs la khral khrims nges par du yod dgos/ de'i phyir dpya khral gyi yong 'bab ni rgyal khab kyis de'i 'gan nus mngon gyur yong ched chab srid kyi dbang cha bed spyad cing khrims lugs ltar skyin pa ster mi dgos par thob pa'i nor srid yong 'bab kyi gzhi rtsa'i rnam pa zhig red/ don dam par dpya khral zhes pa ni rgyal khab kyis gla yon dang 'gro song gang yang ma btang bar sdod dmangs kyi lag nas blangs pa'i dngul lor sogs yin/dpya khral la btsan shed rang bzhin dang skyin pa med pa'i rang 42

bzhin/ gtan 'jags rang bzhin bcas khyad rtags gsum yod/ dpya khral gyi btsan shed rang bzhin ni dpya khral de rgyal khab kyi chab srid dbang char brten nas btsan shed kyis bsdu len byed pa la zer/ skyin pa med pa'i rang bzhin ni rgyal khab la thob pa'i dpya khral gyi yong 'bab de dpya khral 'jal mkhan la skyin pa ster mi dgos pa la zer/ gtan 'jags rang bzhin ni dpya khral bsdu len ma byas gong bca' khrims kyi go rim brgyud de dpya khral bsdu len byed yul dang bsdu len byed grangs bar gyi sdur tshad gtan khel btang ba de rgyal khab kyis chog mchan ma bkod bar du sus kyang bcos sgyur byed mi chog dpya khral gyi khyad rtags 'di gsum po'i bar gyi 'brel ba dam zhing phan tshun kha 'bral mi rung /khrim/sa lugs ltar dpya khral 'jal ba ni spyi dmangs kun gyi rtsa ba'i 'os 'gan yin/ de yang spyi tshogs thog dpya khral 'jal ba'i skabs su khrims lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bya spyod dus rgyun byung 'dug dper na dpya khral skung ba/ de ni dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyis bsam bzhin du khral khrims kyi gtan 43

khel la rgyab 'gal byas te g.yol thabs dang sbas skung sogs thabs ci risas spyad de dpya khral 'jal bar g.yol ba'i bya spyod la zer/ dpya khral gyi chad pa de ni dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyis khral bsdu las khungs kyis gtan khel byas pa'i dus tshod ltar khral ma 'jal bar khral 'jal dus yun nar 'gyangs byas pa'i bya spyod la zer/ dpya khral bslu ba de ni dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyis mgo skor btang nas rgyal khab kyi dpya khral gang thub kyis nyung 'jal byed pa'i bya spyod la zer/dpya khral rgal ba ni dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyis khral khrims kyi gtan khel la brtsi srung ma byas par khral khrims la rgyab 'gal byas pa'i bya spyod la zer/ gong smos kyi bya spyod de dag rgyal khab kyi khrims lugs dang mi mthun pas nges par du yo bsrang byed dgos/ spyi tshogs ring lugs rgyal khab kyis rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khe phan la 'bad brtson byed pa dang /rgyal khab srid dbang las khungs kyi dmigs yul mi mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba de red/ rgyal khab kyis ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis brtson 'gros la brten nas thob pa'i rgyu 44

nor de dpya khral sdud pa'i rnam par brten nas gcig bsdus byas te dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang tshan rig slob gso/rig gnas/ 'phrod bsten/ spyi tshogs gtan 'jags/ rgyal srung sogs rgyal khab dang mi dmangs spyi tshogs spyi la phan bde sgrub pa'i las don thog thad kur bkol bas/ don dam par ngal rtsol mi dmangs la khe phan thob pa'i don du zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang / ngal rtsol mi dmangs ni dpya khral gyi yong 'bab la longs spyod byed mkhan ngo ma bo yin/ de'i phyir spyi tshogs ring lugs rgyal khab kyi dpya khral gyi yong 'bab de mi dmangs kyi lag nas bsdu len byas te slar yang mi dmangs kyi don du bkol spyod byed pa'i khral sdud lam lugs gsar ba zhig yin/rang rgyal gyi khral sdud la nus pa gsum yod pa ni/ dang po khral sdud de nor srid yong 'bab sgrub byed kyi rtsa ba'i rnam pa zhig yin/ gnyis pa khral sdud ni dpal 'byor snyom sgrig byed pa'i 'degs shing lta bu red/ gsum pa khral sdud de rgyal khab kyis dpal 'byor la lta skul byed pa'i thabs shes gal 45

chen zhig yin/ rang rgyal gyi khral rigs gtso bo ni dang po gnas thang 'phar ba'i dpya khral/ de ni dpya khral 'jal mkhan gyis thon skyed las gnyer gyi bya 'gul spel ba'i khrod du gnas thang 'phar ba'i yong 'bab de dpya khral bsdu yul byed pa'i khral rigs shig yin/ gnyis pa las gnyer dpya khral/de ni bdag gnyer byed pa'i bya 'gul nang las gnyer yong 'bab de dpya khral bsdu yul byed pa'i khral rigs shig go /gsum pa 'dzad spyod dpya khral/ de ni 'dzad spyod dngos rdzas dang 'dzad spyod bya spyod la dmigs nas bsdu ba'i khral rigs shig yin/ bzhi ba khe las yong 'bab kyi thob khral/ de ni khe las kyis dus tshod nges can nang bdag gnyer byas pa las thob pa'i yong 'bab la dmigs te bsdu ba'i khral rigs shig yin/ lnga ba mi sger gyi yong 'bab thob khral/ de ni rgyal khab kyis mi sger la thob pa'i yong 'bab der dmigs te bsdu ba'i khral rigs shig yin/ drug pa sgo khral/ de ni krung go rgyal khab kyi rgyal khongs nas phyi gtong nang 'dren byed pa'i tshong zog la bsdu ba'i khral rigs shig go /dpya khral de rigs 'jal 46

mkhan ni tshong zog phyir gtong mkhan dang nang 'dren mkhan gnyis yin/ spyir rang rgyal du khral rigs nyi shu lhag yod la/khrims lugs ltar du dpya khral 'jal ba de spyi dmangs kun gyis dang len byed dgos pa'i 'os 'gan yin/bcu bzhi ba/ rin thang chos nyid/rin thang chos nyid ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid yin pa dang / de'i rtsa ba'i nang don ni tshong zog gi rin thang de tshong zog thon skyed byed pa'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos nges ngal rtsol dus tshod kyis thag gcod byed pa dang / tshong zog brje res de rin thang 'dra mnyam gyi rtsa don rmang gzhi byas te brje res byed pa red/ tshong zog brje res ni tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan bar phan tshun la ngal rtsol brje res byed pa gzhir bzung nas tshong zog rigs gnyis spyi tshogs kyi dgos nges ngal rtsol dus tshod kyis thag gcod byas pa'i rin thang gi tshad la gzhigs te brje res byas pas/ tshong zog brje res de thon skyed mkhan rang gzhan gnyis skar phan pa red/47

dngul lor yod pa nas bzung tshong zog gi rin thang la dngul lor gyis bsdur zhib byas te rin gong gi rnam pa mtshon/rin mnyam brje res byed pa der nges par du rin gong rin thang dang 'os 'tshams yin dgos/ 'on kyang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang du rin gong rin thang dang 'os 'tshams shig byung dka'/ rin gong rin thang la brten nas 'phar chag byed kyin yod pa ni rin thang chos nyid kyi mtshon stangs yin/tshong ra'i nang du rin gong dang rin thang la rgyab 'gal byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni tshong ra'i nang du tshong zog 'don sprod dang dgos mkho bar do mnyam yong med pa de red/ rin gong 'phar na 'don sprod mang la dgos mkho nyung / rin gong chag na dgos mkho mang zhing 'don sprod nyung / 'on kyang rin thang chos nyid kyi nus pa'i 'og de 'dra'i gnas tshul rgyun ldan ma yin par skabs 'gar de las ldog pa'ang yod/ rin gong la 'phar chag byung ba des tshong zog gi 'don sprod dang dgos mkhor shugs rkyen thebs pa red/ gal te tshong zog zhig gi rin gong de rin thang las mtho na tshong zog thon skyed byed 48

mkhan gyis tshong zog de rigs thon skyed mang po byed par brten mkho sprod mang drags pas rin gong chag pa dang / tshong zog zhig gi rin gong de rin thang las dma' na tshong zog thon skyed byed mkhan gyis tshong zog de rigs thon skyed mang po mi byed par brten mkho sprod nyung bas rin gong yang 'phar 'gro/ 'on kyang rin gong rin thang la gzhigs te 'phar chag byung ba ni rin thang chos nyid dang rgyab 'gal ma yin par de ni rin thang chos nyid la mtshon na ha cang rgyun ldan yin/rin gong la 'phar chag ci 'dra byung na'ang mjug mthar rin gong rin thang dang phal cher 'os 'tshams yong ba de rin thang chos nyid kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lugs yin/bco lnga ba/ thon las chen po gsum/thon las dang po ni zhing las yin la/ der 'debs 'dzugs las rigs dang nags las dang phyugs las/ zhor las/ nya las bcas las rigs lnga 'dus yod pas spyir btang du zhing las chen po zer/ zhing las ni rgyal dmangs 49

dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi yin/ mar khe sis ngal rtsol pa rang nyid kyi dgos mkho las brgal ba'i zhing las thon skyed ni spyi tshogs ma/tha' dag gi rmang gzhi yin zhes gsungs/thon las gnyis pa ni bzo las dang ar las las rigs la zer/ bzo las kyi khongs su sngog 'don bzo las dang bzo skrun las rigs/ de min da dung rang 'bab chu/ glog shugs/rlangs gzugs/ chu tshan/ sol rlangs sogs tshud pa red/bzo las la yang lci ba'i bzo las dang yang ba'i bzo las zhes gnyis yod de/ lci ba'i bzo las ni gtso bo thon skyed rgyu cha'i thon skyed sde khag yin pa dang / de'i nang sngog 'don bzo las dang / ma bcos rgyu cha'i bzo las/ 'bar rdzas sgul shugs bzo las/ 'phrul chas bzo skrun las rigs sogs 'dus yod/ yang ba'i bzo las ni gtso bo 'dzad spyod rgyu cha thon skyed kyi sde khag yin pa/ de'i nang 'khel 'thag bzo las dang za bca' bzo las/ ko lpags bzo las/ shog bu bzo las sogs 'dus yod/ ar las las rigs la ar las sgrig sbyor khe las dang sger sanyer 'dzugs skrun las khungs/50

de min da dung ar las sgrig sbyor gyi las grwar zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i sa gshis rtsad zhib jus 'god sogs 'dus yod/lag rtsal chu tshad dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad mtho dman de rgyal khab de'i bzo las 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad la rag las yod/ de'i phyir rang rgyal gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can mngon 'gyur 'byung dgos na nges par du bzo las gong 'phel shugs chen gtong dgos/thon las gsum pa ni spyi tshogs thon skyed dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan gyi las rigs sna tshogs la zer/ rang rgyal nas thon las gsum par rim pa bzhi dbye ste/ rim pa dang po ni 'khor rgyug sde khag yin la/ de'i nang 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren las rigs dang yig skyel glog 'phrin las rigs/ tshong don las rigs/ bza' btung las rigs/ dngos rdzas mkho 'tshong las rigs bcas 'dus yod/ rim pa gnyis pa ni thon skyed dang 'tsho bar zhabs zhu'i sde khag yin/ de'i nang dngul rtsa'i las rigs dang nyen 'gog 'gan len las rigs/ phyogs bsdus lag rtsal skor gyi 51

zhabs zhu'i las rigs/ zhing las dang nags las/ phyugs 'a sa/ nya las/ chu bed bcas la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i las rigs dang chu bed las rigs/ blo 'don las rigs dang brda 'phrin las rigs/ sa khang bdag khongs las rigs sa gshis yongs khyab rtsad zhib las rigs/ sdod dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i las rigs/ yul skor las rigs/ spyi spyod las don/ de min da dung gzhung lam dang nang khul chu bo'i(mtshe'u)gru lam bcas kyi bdag skyong las rigs sogs 'dus yod/ rim pa gsum pa ni tshan rig dang rig gnas chu tshad dang sdod dmangs kyi byang tshad mtho ru 'degs par zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i sde khag yin/ de'i nang slob gso dang rig gnas/ rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin las don/ tshan rig zhib 'jug las don/ 'phrod bsten/ lus rtsal/ spyi tshogs phan bde'i las don sogs 'dus yod/ rim pa bzhi ba ni spyi tshogs spyi la mkho ba'i zhabs zhu'i sde khag yin/ der rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang tang srid las khungs/ spyi tshogs tshogs pa/dmag dpung dang nyen rtog pa sogs 'dus yod/52

le'u gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs/dang po/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la ngo sprod/1994lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo ro kho'i grong khyer ma la kho hre nas tshogs pa'i slo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig gi wu ra ku'e res skor gyi pu'u krang tshogs 'du'i thog 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs(5ga0)'dzugs rgyu'i gtan khel byas nas1947lor btsugs pa'i sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig(0 khu)gi tshab byas pa red/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs dang 'dzam gling dngul khang / rgyal spyi'i dngul lor thebs rtsa rtsa 'dzugs gsum la rgyal spyi'i dpal 'byor ma lag gi ka rten chen po gsum dang / yang na dpal 'byor gyi mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs zhes 'bod kyin yod/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs de 'dzugs pa'i bsam 'char de1947lo'i zla bdun par tshogs pa'i pu'u le tun gyi 53

nags tshal skor gyi tshogs 'du'i thog bton pa red/ 1947lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi nyo tshong dang las zhugs gros tshogs thog ming rtags bkod pa'i〈〈ha wa na rtsa 'dzin〉〉nang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs 'dzugs par gros mthun byung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang a me ri khas ngo rgol byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs de 'dzugs ma thub/ lo der a me ri khas sgo khral dang nyo tshong spyi'i chod yig gtan khel byed pa'i gros gzhi bton nas nyo tshong rang dbang can khyab spel gtong rgyu'i gnas skabs kyi gan rgyar brtsis pa red 1986lor sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig gi wu ra ga'e res skor gros mol tshogs 'du mgo tshugs rjes yo rob thun mong tshogs pa dang kha na ta khag so sos1990lor 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gzhi dngos su bton/1995lo'i zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin las don dngos su byed mgo tshugs nas 'dzam gling gi dpal 'byor dang nyo tshong sgrig lam la do dam byed pa'i 'gan 'khur bzhin yod cing / spyi khyab khang ni ri ne wa'i meng mtshe'u 'gram gyi sgo khral dang nyo 54

tshong spyi'i chod yig gi spyi khyab khang gi thog khang du tshugs/1996lo'i zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin nas sgo khral dang nyo tshong spyi'i chod yig gi gnas skabs las khungs kyi tshab dngos su byas pa red/ de yang nga tshos shes gsal ltar 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'byung khungs ni19 7lo'i zla bcu bar btsugs pa'i sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig de red/skabs der krung go rgyal khab ni thog mar chod yig 'jog mkhan rgyal khab23yod pa'i nang gi gcig yin mod/ 'on kyang/950lo'i zla gsum par tha'e wan go min tang dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig nas phyir 'then bya rgyu khyab bsgrags byas rjes rang rgyal dus yun ring bor sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig gi phyir rol du phud/ de'i phyir tshang mas dus rgyun sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig 'jog malan rgyal khab dang sa khul gras su slar zhusas dang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa/ zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ 1986lo'i zla bdun par krung go rgyal khab kyis sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig 5da

'jog mkhan rgyal khab dang sa khul gyi gras su chings yig 'jog mkhan rgyal khab kyi bo gnas slar gso byed pa'i zhu yig phul ba nas krung go rgyal khab dang a me ri kha'i bar krung bo/ rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs par phyogs gnyis kur gros mthun byung ba'i bar dus yu/na lo ngo13'gor song / dpal 'byor sa'i go la hril po can gyi 'phel rim la rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs gsar ba zhig mkho ba'i rkyen gyis 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs btsugs pa red/ don la rtsa 'dzugs de ni sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig gi rmang gzhir brten te btsugs pa zhig yin la/ rtsa 'dzugs de 'dzam gling du ches che ba'i phyogs mang nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs yin pas da snga rgyal khab dang sa khul135rtsa 'dzugs der zhugs/sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig dang bsdu ra na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi do dam byed khongs su sngar yod tshong zog nyo tshong gi skor gyi don tshan phud da dung yun ring sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig nang tshud med pa'i 56

shes yon gyi thon dngos bdag dbang dang ma dngul 'jog pa/tshong zog nyo tshong ma yin pa ste zhabs zhu'i nyo tshong sogs 'dus yod/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis tshong zog dang zhabs zhu'i nyo tshong rang dbang can/ shes yon gyi thon dngos bdag dbang srung skyong dang nyo tshong khrims lugs khrom bsgrags byed pa sogs la skul 'ded gtong bar sto bas shugs chen po phud cing / nyo tshong srid jus kyi gros zhib lam lugs dang rtsod gzhi byung bar thag gcod byed pa'i lam lugs brgyud de 'dzam gling nyo tshong dang ma dngul 'jog par shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyin yod/ 'dzam/ gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs de rgyal spyi'i nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs yin pa'i cha nas khrims lugs thog mnyam 'brel rgya'aku tshogs sogs rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dang 'dra mnyam gyi thob thang yod cing / de'i 'gan 'khri'i khyab khongs ni sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yig la sngar yod kyi phyogs mang nyo tshong gros mol don tshan don 'khyol dang phyogs mang nyo tshong gros mol byed sa mkho sprod byed nga// dus bcad ltar khongs mi'i nyo tshong srid jus gros 57

zhib dang / gocig gyur thog khongs mi'i bar nyo tshong rtsod gzhi byung bar thag gcod byed pa'i 'gan khur bar ma zad/ rgyal spyi'i dngul lor thebs rtsa rtsa 'dzugs dang 'dzam gling dngul khang bar mnyam las bya rgyur shugs snon brgyab nas 'dzam gling yongs kyi dpal 'byor thabs jus gcig mthun yong ba'i 'gan khur yod/lo mang po'i ring la nga tshos blo brtan 'gyur med kyi sgo nas sgo khral dang nyo tshong bi spyi'i chod yig nang chings yig 'jog mkhan rgyal khab kyi thob thang slar gso byed pa dang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs par brtson len byas te phyi phyogs nyo tshong sgrig srol la bcos sgyur gang legs byed pa dang / tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi sgrig srol gsar ba 'dzugs pa/ khe las kyi 'gran rtsod nus pa je cher btang nas 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzags nang zhugs par gra sgris gang thub byas/ de yang rang re'i rgyal khab 'di sgo khral dang nyo tshong gi spyi'i chod yi ga 'jog mkhan rgya'/ khab dang sa khul gyi gras su slar gso byed pa dang yang na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 58

'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni rgyal khab kyi phyogs bsdus stobs shugs je rgyas su gtong ba dang rgyal dmangs kyi byang tshad khyon yongs nas mthor 'degs byed pa/rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor sngar las lhag par gong 'phel du gtong dgos pa sogs yin no/ /gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi grub tshul/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi ches mtho'i thabs jus gtan khel gyi dbang 'dzin las khungs ni pu'u krang tshogs 'du yin zhing / ha lam lo gnyis nang tshogs 'du thengs gcig tshogs kyin yod/ de'i mnga' 'og tu spyi khyab las 'dzin lhan tshogs dang drung yig khang btsugs yod pa des 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyun ldan gyi tshogs 'du dang las ku'i 'gan 'khur gyin yod/ spyi khyab las 'dzin lhan tshogs kyi mnga' 'og tu tshong zog nyo tshong dang / tshong zog nyo tshong ma yin pa'i zhabs zhu'i nyo tshong / shes yon gyi thon dngos bdag dbang bcas kyi las 'dzin lhan tshogs gsum 59

dang / nyo tshong / gong spel/ sngon rtsis u yon lhan khang gnyis bcas btsugs/ spyi khyab las 'dzin lhan tshogs kyi mnga' 'og tu da dung nyo tshong srid jus zhib rtsis las khungs btsugs yod pa dang des u yon lhan khang khag la lta skul byed par ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi srid jus la dpyad bsdur gdeng 'jog gi snyan zhu'i 'char gzhi 'god rgyu'i 'gan 'khur gyin yod/ de yang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi grub tshul bye bras pa de gsham gsal gyi dpe ris nang gsal bor bkod yod/60

gsum pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig lam/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs de rgyal spyi'i bca' khrims kyis chog mchan bkod pa ltar btsugs pa yin zhing khrims mi'i thob thang ldan pas/ de ni 'thor thabs med pa'i rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs shig yin/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs rgyu yin na nges par du rtsa 'dzugs de ra zhugs pa'i rgyal khab kyi khrims 'dzugs sde khag gis rgyal spyi'i khrims lugs dang rgyal khab nang khul gyi khrims lugs/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khrims lugs gzhir bzung nas chog mchan bkod pa yin/ de'i phyir 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs rgyu yin pa'i rgyal khab so sos 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i bca' khrim/sa kyi 'brel yod don tshan logs su rgyal spyi'i bca' khrims dang nges par du mthun dgos/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis gtan khel byas pa'i sgrig lam ltar na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis bdag gnyer byed pa'i khyab khongs su dngos 62

zog dang zhabs zhu/ shes rig thon dbang bcas rnam grangs rigs chen po gsum 'dus yod/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsa ba'i don snying ni nyo tshong rang mos la skul spel dang dpal 'byor sa'i go la hril bo rang mos can la skul 'ded byas te sgo khral nyung 'phri byed pa dang sgo khral gyi bar bkag med par btang ste 'dzam gling nyo tshong la bar chad mi gtong bar bde thang yin pa'i lam phyogs la 'phel zhing rang mo/sa kyis nyo tshong byer )pa nge yin/ ngon la 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs ni tshong ra dang sgrig lam rkenyis ngo bo gcig gyur yin pa dang / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i rgyal khab kun gyi nyo tshong srid jus brje res byed pa'i tshong ra yin la/ rgyal khab de dag gi srid gzhung gis tshong ra de'i nang du gong gtam pa dang zam ma chad par rtsod pa brgyab ste mjug mthar 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs zin pa'i rgyal khab tshang mas gros 'cham byung dgos pa'i sgrig lam zhig 'dzugs pa red/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig lam gyis phyogs ston byed pa las mjug 'bras bzang ngan la 63

mi lta/ de'i phyir 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis drang gzhag dang rang mos can gyi nyo tshong gi rol rtsed sgrig lam zhig gtan khel byas mod kyang sgrig lam de dag lag len du bstar ba las grub pa'i bye brag gi 'bras bur lta rtog mi byed/'angom gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs 'dod na nges par du ma rtsa 'jog dgos/ ma rtsa de nyung mtha' yang rang gi rgyal khab kyi nyo tshong gi gtso dbang kha shas 'dor dgos pa red/dper na sgo khral je mthor gtong mi chog la sgo khral gyi bar bkag bzo mi chog bcas lta bu'o/ /'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'dem shog 'phen pa'i rtsa don ni rgyal khab gang yin par che chung dang dbul phyug 'phel rgyas dang rjes lus kyi khyad par med la/ rgyal khab gcig la 'dem shog gcig ma gtogs 'phen dbang med/ dus mtshungs su gros gzhi gal chen la nges par du 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i rgyal khab tshang mas gros 'cham byung dgos/ rang rgyal gyis nges par du 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs yod pa'i rgyal khab135dang re re bzhin gros mol byas te gros 64

'cham byung dus da gzod 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs chog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig lam gyi gtan khel la gzhigs na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la rtsa ba'i rtsa don brgyad yod pa 'di lta ste/dang po mthong chung med pa'i thob thang gi rtsa don/ gnyis pa gzigs skyong che shos byed pa'i rgyal khab kyi rtsa don/ gsum pa rgyal dmangs thob thang gi rtsa don/ bzhi ba phan tshun la phan thogs pa'i rtsa don/ lnga ba sgo khral nyung 'phri byed pa'i rtsa don/drug pa grangs tshad la tshod 'dzin mi byed pa'i rtsa don/ bdun pa gsal bsgrags byed pa'i rtsa don/ brgyad pa pham tshong rgyag par bkag sdom byed pa'i rtsa don bcas so /bzhi ba/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim/krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la zhugs pa ni sa'i go la hril bo'i rgyun ldan gyi nyo tshong dbang cha longs spyod byed pa'i mtshon rtags yin mod/ 'on kyang dang len 65

byed dgos pa'i 'os 'gan la nges par du brtsi srung byed dgos/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs kyang nyo tshong dang 'brel ba'i rtsod gzhi de nam yang tshar rgyu med/ de'i phyir rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor rtsa ba'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe mi phog pa'i ched du 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khrims lugs la brten te rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim la rgyus lon gsal bo byed dgos/ spyir btang du bshad na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim la dus rim bzhir bkar chog dang ngo ni nyo tshong bar rtsod gzhi byung dus thog mar do bdag phyogs gnyis mas phan tshun gyi gnas tshul rgyus lon dang lta tshul brje res byed ched gros mol byed yun gtan khel byed dgos par ma zad/gang thub kyis nang 'dum byung na rab yin/ do bdag phyogs gcig gis rtsod gzhi thag gcod pa'i re 'dun zhus pa nas nyin sum cu 'gor dus gros bsdur byed mgo brtsam dgos/gal srid re 'dun zhus nas nyin drug cu nang da dung thag gcod byed ma thub na/ do bdag phyogs gnyis gas kyang ched 66

mkhas tshan chung 'dzugs pa'i re 'dun zhu chog la/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod las khungs kyis re 'dun zhu yig lag tu 'byor tshe thengs gnyis pa'i tshogs 'du'i thog gros 'cham byung yod med kyi gsal bshad gnang dgos/ rtsod gzhi thag gcod las khungs kyi khongs mi tshang ma 'thad pa byung dus da gzod ched mkhas tshan chung 'dzugs chog gnyis pa ni ched mkhas tshan chung de mi gsum las grub cing des rtsod gzhi'i zhu yig la zla ba drug nang khrun thag gcod dgos la/ dus yun ches ring na'ang zla ba dgu las 'da' mi rung / gal srid tshong zog khyad par can dang brel che ba'i tshong don la 'phrad tshe zla ba gsum nang khrun thag gcod dgos/ khrun thag chod yig de 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi rnams kyis res gzigs byas te nyin nyi shu nas drug cu bar gros 'cham byung min thag gcod dgos/dus yun der do bdag gis khrun thag bcad par khas mi len na gong gtug byed chog ched mkhas pa gsum gyi tshan chung gis kyang mjug mtha'i khrun thag gcod dgos/ gsum pa ni 67

khrun thag chod don la nus pa thon tshe do bdag phyogs gnyis yis nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis gtan khel gnang ba ltar lag bstar byed pa'i dus tshod gros bsdur byed dgos/ spyir btang du nyin bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i nang lag len du bstar rgyu yin/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs dang de'i khongs mi rnams kyis lag bstar byed par thog mtha' bar gsum du lta skul byed chog bzhi ba ni 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la zhugs pa'i rgyal khab kyis de'i rtsa don brtsi srung mi byed par khrims 'gal lugs min gyi bya spyod byung dus 'brel yod gtan khel bzhin du chad pa gcod nges yin/ dper na sgo khral je nyung du mi gtong ba sogs lta bu'o/ /rang re'i rgyal khab la mtshon na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs na nges par du gsham gsal gyi gtso gnad 'gar do snang byed dgos/ dang po nyo tshong gi rtsod gzhi thag gcod gang legs byed pa'i ched du srid gzhung dang thon las sde khag gis 'dzam gling nyo tshong gi sgrig khrims don tshan la byang cha yod pa'i mi sna skyed sring byed dgos/ gnyis pa 68

'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs rjes rtsod gzhi'i gtug bsher byung ba der 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim ltar bsgrub dgos par ma zad/ thon las sde khag dang khe las yongs kyis nan tan sgo sa rtsod gzhi thag gcod drang gzhag yong bar 'bad brtson byed pa dang / rtsod gzhi'i gtug bsher dang 'brel yod cha 'phrin dang dpyad gzhi sogs la cha tshang zhing yang dag pa dang tshad ldan bcas kyi gdeng tshod 'dzin dgos/ gsum pa ched las kyi cha nas rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs byed pa dang / 'brel yod rtsod gzhi'i dpe mtshon la rgyus lon byed dgos la 'dzam gling nyo tshong gros mthun gyi sgrig lam dang de'i skor gyi khrims lugs khong du chud pa'i mkhas pa rnams dang mnyam du rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed thabs la zhib 'jug byas te ci thub gang thub kyis dpal 'byor thad gyong gud mi gtong / bzhi ba 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khrim sa lusas bkol spyod gang legs byas te 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig khrims la brtsi srung mi byed pa dang /69

lugs mthun ma yin pa'i nyo tshong byed mkhan la 'thab rtsod byas nas 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs dang rang re'i rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor khe phan la srung skyong gang thub byed dgos/de yang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i go rim bye brag pa de gsham gsal re'u mig nang gsal bor bkod yod/70

ngajang gring nyo tshong rtsa 2dzwabs kyes rtsod gzhi thag gcod gos bsdur byer nga zi co rim re'u mis༄ spyi byub 'a sa sa pa/sa bar 'durnga/ byed pa /rtsong la0 sdo—rwacong nga zo 4 ngarnga —— /2ban dngang rtserub 'ongs za ca bas maca se sdub sag/za mabs pho ca gi'ib dbya da dang phyo0ra rṣalo tshos ro las mi sna'i 'ib dbya da pho chang /— — 2dudaX phyongadas/la ri'itshogoXhrū—— —— ༄cheng ru bas dngha chung gis do bdab byo bas banyis / dusari bar cha 'i bye lta 'i zhu ri ba 'angon pa / bheza rje lnge ro/de pozlo ḍūco'ertsodabazhi༄ma bcod la sa khungs nas resabazi0sabyedang / rṣama'asatshocabizhuyis la rtsordolorāche // song satug zhib dbya da/—bconga'asakhungs/0/res4bzibasabye dpa/ //song sa dub 'ib dbya da 'a rtsod sazhi thas bcod /— —tram̐ gasda shanagāgom 'ab byud ba bre ngan 5 rsharsha 'angaXng— rje rne thong —rje daco ra sku ngagani ṭardod ḍachasarsha ra tā hūṃ ga cu sde zu nga bani tram̐zhu gucorda— ༷ /khyasnaX ༈྅ skyo bya(narsha sabasnyi ra byeje5 / —༷bsnyiramabyatsangardo bdogu rmyoṭasnaṭanyisna ༄ skyo ma rtsi don za yi sdo5rno5byed pa / ༷ — riru ror brdo cho nga rtsordo sarno je kya sa/nga rā ga3 rsha ༷de 'pho 3 na rteskyo da ba rjesgo pre/—71

lnga ba/ krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i longs spyod khe dbang /'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i rgyal khab dag gis khe dbang 'di 'drar longs spyod byed chog dang po tshong zog dang zhabs zhu/ shes bya'i thon dbang / tshong ra'i sgo 'byed sogs kyi thad du mthong chung mi byed pa'i thob thang longs spyod byed chog pa dang nang sgos su 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab135lhag gi bar phyogs mang dang cha rkyen med pa/ brtan po bcas kyi ches gzigs skyong byed sa'i rgyal khab kyi thob thang longs su spyod chog de min krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa nas bzung der khongs zhugs rgyal khab khrod nas rgyal dmangs thob thang longs spyod byed chog des kyang 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab dag sis krung go rgyal khab phyogs su sngar las sgo mo ches cher phye bar brten krung go rgyal khab la lhag tu rgya che ba'i rgyal spyi'i tshong ra 72

thob thub pas/ krung go rgyal khab kyi thon rdzas phyir btsongs nas phyi 'brel dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la phan thogs chen po yod/ gnyis pa 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab la sprad pa'i dmigs bsal thob thang sna tshogs longs spyod byed chog 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab spyi dang khyad par du dar rgyas min pa'i rgyal khab kyis tshong zog phyir tshong la skul ma dang khag theg byed pa'i ched du 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab kyis thon rdzas grub ma dang phyed grub thon rdzas phyir tshong byed dus sgo khral nyung 'jal dang yang na 'jal mi dgos pa'i gzigs skyong sgrig srol gtan khel byas/ der yongs khyab gzigs skyong lam lugs kyi thob thang yang zer/ krung go 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs su zhugs pa nas bzung yongs khyab gzigs skyong lam 'u gas kyi thob thang la longs spyod byed pa'i khyab khongs sngar las kyang rgya je cher gtong thub pas/ krung go rgyal khab tshong rdzas phyir tshong bi rgya'/ spyi'i 'gran rtsod nus shugs mthor 'degs byed thub pa dang krung go rgyal khab kyi tshong zog 73

phyir tshong bya yul rgyal khab je mang du gtong thub/ gsum pa 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi nyo tshong rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa'i nang rkyen dang go rim bed spyad nas drang gzhag dang don mthun lugs mthun gyi sgo nas rgyal khab gzhan dag bar gyi dpal 'byor nyo tshong rtsod gzhi thag gcod byas nas rang rgyal gyi dpal 'byor khe phan srung skyob dang / dpal 'byor nyo tshong las don 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i khor yug yag po bskrun zhing / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig srol dag bed spyad nas rgyal khab rang gi dpa/la 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i khe dbang yod/ bzhi ba phyogs mang nyo tshong sgrig gzhi'i gros mol la zhugs pa dang / rgyal spyi'i dpal 'byor dang nyo tshong gi sgrig lam gtan khel byed pa'i khe dbang yod/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs ni mig sngar ches che ba'i rgyal spyi'i dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs shig yin pas/ rgyal spyi'i dpal 'byor gyi sgrig lam gal chen gtan khel dang lag bstar byed pa red/ de'i phyir mi rnams kyis 'dzam/ gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs la dpal 'byor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs 74

kyang zer/ gal srid 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab min dus 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi gros mol dang sgrig srol gtan khel la zhugs pa'i go skabs med pas rang gi rgyal khab kyi khe dbang dang khe phan bcas la srung skyob byed pa'i go skabs med par ma zad/ rang rgyal gyi rgyal spyi'i chab srid dpal 'byor gyi go gnas mthor 'degs byed mi thub/ krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa nas bzung rtsa 'dzugs des bton pa'i gros gzhi so sor gros mol dang nyo tshong sgrig srol gyi gtan 'bebs la zhugs chog pas krung go rgyal khab rang nyid kyi blang bya dang re 'dun mtshon gang thub byed chog des kyang krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs khrod kyi go gnas dang lugs mthun khe phan srung skyob byed par phan thogs shing drang gzhag lugs mthun gyi sgo nas rgyal spyi'i dpal 'byor sgrig srol gsar 'dzugs dang srung skyob thad sngar las lhag pa'i nus pa 'don thub bo/ /75

drug pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol/rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol zer ba ni dus rgyun rgyal spyi'i 'brel gtug khrod lag len yang yang byas par ma zad/ tshang ma/ra cha rgyus yod la mnyam du spyod bzhin pa'i rgyun srol gyi byed stangs la zer ba red/ der rigs gnyis yod de/ dang po ni khrim sa lugs kyi gcun nus ldan pa dper na 'brel yod rgyal lab zhugs pa'i phyogs gnyis chod yig dang phyogs mang chings yig sogs lta bu yin/ gnyis pa ni khrims 'u gas kyi bcun nus mi ldan pa de rgyun du rgyal spyi'i nyo tshong khrod du grub pa'i rgyun srol gyi byed stangs la zer/ der tshong 'a sa rgyun srol yang zer/ dper na zog 'dzin yid rton lag khyer sgrig srol dang zog dngul mngag bsdu dang dngul 'grul 'dzin shog ltar zog dngul sprod gtong byed pa'i sgrig srol / de bzhin rgya' spyi'i nyo tshong ma thun tshogs kyis gtan la —4ba pa'i rgyal spyi'i nyo tshong tha snyad sogs lta bu yin/ rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol de rigs 76

ni rgyun du dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab nyung shas kyi las rigs dang khe las nang thun mong du spyod bzhin pa dang / de nas rgyal spyi'i tshong rar khyab gdal byas pa dang sbrags yongs khyab tu khas len pa red/ spyir btang du bshad na tshong las rgyun srol ni las rigs nang khul gyi sgrig srol 'dzugs pa dang /tshang mas mnyam spyod byed pa las/ phyi phyogs la nus pa mi thon/ 'on kyang da lta'i rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol mi nyung ba zhig ni sngon la nang khul gyi mi snar gcun pa mi byed la las rigs phyi yi mi snar gcun pa red/ rgyal khab ga ge mo zhig gi nyo tshong goms srol de rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol du gyur dgos pa'i nges pa med/ sgrog srol zhig bzos te rgyal khab gzhan la brtsi srung byed du bcug pa de yang rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol yin pa'i nges pa med/ phan nus ldan pa'i rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol gang zhig gis kyang nges par du las rigs thams cad tshad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas yong bar phan thogs pa las rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig dang las rigs gang 'dra zhig dang las rigs gang 'dra zhig gi nyo tshong sgrig srol de thad kur rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol 77

la brtsis nas lag bstar byas na mi 'grigarang rgyal gyis rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol nang 'dren byed skabs don tshan lngar dmigs su bkar nas do snang bya dgos/gcig ni nang 'dren byas pa'i rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol der tshang mas khas len pa dang / rgyal spyi'i thog yongs khyab tu brtsi srung byed bzhin pa'i rgyun srol zhig yin pa las rgyal khab nyung shas dang khe las nyung shas kyis khas len pa dang bkol spyod byed pa'i rgyun srol min/ gnyis ni rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol de 'dra mnyam dang / drang gzhag lugs mthun yin dgos/ gsum ni rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol de rang rgyal gyis lag bstar byed bzhin pa'i bca' khrims dang khrims srol la mthun min lta dgos/bzhi ni krung go rgyal khab kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang srol rgyun gyi 'dzad spyod goms gshis/ tshong las goms gshis bcas dang mthun dgos pa dang / nang sgos su krung go rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun dgos/ de 'dra min na khyab spel btang yang lag bstar dngos su byed mi thub/ lnga ni las rigs mthun tshogs kyis rgyal spyi'i rgyun srol nang 'dren 78

byed skabs tshogs mir 'os 'gan mang tsam gtan 'bebs bya rgyur do snang byed dgos/ tshong rogs dang 'gran rtsod pa/'dzad spyod pa bcas dang 'brel ba'i las rigs bya spyod yin phyin nges par du drang gzhag gi nyo tshong dang 'dra mnyam gyi 'gran rtsod byed pa'i blang bya dang mthun dgos la tshong las mi chos dar spel gtong dgos/ lhag par du gzhan gyi bsgrub dgos pa'i 'os 'gan dang mi gzhan gyi khe phan la gnod pa bskyal thub pa'i don tshan gtan 'bebs byed dus nges par du gzab nan bya dgos/bdun pa/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyun sdod sku tshab tshogs pa/rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab dag gis rtsa 'dzugs de'i nang rang nyid kyi khe dbang 'gan len dang 'brel yod nyo tshong dang nyo tshong bar byung ba'i rtsod gzhi/ sgrig lam 'gal ba sogs lta bu'i gnad don ci rigs thag gcod byed pa'i ched du dus rgyun rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs der rgyun sdod 79
