sku tshab tshogs pa mngag gin yod/ rgyun sdod sku tshab tshogs pa ni tshogs gtso dang phyi 'brel mi sna/ srid 'dzin dang lag rtsal mi sna/ spyir tshogs gtsor rgyun sdod sku tshab chen mo zer ba dang / gal te sku tshab de gzhung tshab chen mo/'i rim pa yin na rgyun sdod gzhung tshab chen mo zhes 'bod/ de ni 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang spyod chog pa dang / rgyal spyi'i srid gzhung bar gyi rtsa 'dzugs mtha' dag tu'ang spyod chog dper na rang rgyal gyis mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs dang rgyal spyi'i mtsho 'og do dam cu'u/ rdzas 'gyur mtshon cha bkag 'asog byed pa'i rtsa 'dzugs sogs tshang ma/ra rgyun sdod sku tshab tshogs pa mngags pa lta bu red/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang rgyun sdod kyi krung bo rgyal khab kyi sku tshab tshogs pa ni2002lo'i zla dang po'i zla mjug tu btsugs pa dang / phyi 'brel dpal 'byor nyo tshong pu'u yi pu'u krang gzhon pa sun krin yus 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang rgyun sdod kyi krung go rgyal khab kyi sku tshab dang ched bskos dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mor 80

bskos yod/ sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs mi mang che ba phyi 'brel dpal 'byor nyo tshong pu'u nas yong ba yin/ 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang rgyun sdod kyi krung go rgyal khab kyi sku tshab tshogs pa'i 'gan 'khur gtso bo ni krung go rgyal khab srid gzhung gi tshab byas te 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi drung yig khang dang ri ne war rgyun sdod 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab kyi sku tshab las khungs bar gyi rgyun ldan gyi las don sgrub pa dang / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi las khungs ri ne wa'i spyi khyab khang du 'tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du ci rigs dang gros mol tshogs 'dur zhugs shing rang rgyal khab srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i dbang cha ltar 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i rgyal khab gzhan gyi rgyun sdod sku tshab las khungs bar phyogs mang po'am phyogs gnyis kyi gros mol dang / 'brel gtug gros bsdur sogs bya rgyu'i 'gan 'khur dang len byed pa red/ rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs ni khrims mi'i thob thang ldan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig yin la rgyal spyi'i bca' khrims kyi grub cha gtso bo 81

zhig kyang yin/ rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'gan nus mngon 'gyur yong bar 'gan len pa'i ched du phyogs mang po'i spyi chings dang rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig yig nang rgyun sdod gzhung tshab tshogs pa dang yang na sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs mir dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha dang rang tshugs dbang cha bye brag ngang gtan 'bebs byas pa de dag ni/ dang po gzhung tshab khang ngam sku tshab khang gi khang ba'i thad/ gcig gzhung tshab khang ngam sku tshab khang gi khang bar su zhig gis kyang btsan 'dzul byed mi chog gnas yul rgyal khab kyis gzhung tshab khang ngam sku tshab khang nang gang byung du 'dzul mi chog par ma zad/ da dung gzhung tshab khang ngam sku tshab khang la srung skyob bya rgyu'i 'gan 'khur dang len byed dgos pa dang /gzhung tshab khang ngam sku tshab khang la khrims lugs thog btsan shugs bkol mi chog gnyis yig tshags dang yig char btsan gnod byed mi chog gsum 'phrin gtong rang mos yin/ bzhi dpya khral mi 'jal/ lnga mi sna'i bya spyod dang 'grul skyod rang mos yin/ drug rgyal dar dang rgyal rtags bed spyad byed chog82

gnyis pa mi sna'i thad/ gcig lus khams la gnod 'tshe gtong mi chog gnyis do dam mnga' khongs su rang tshugs dbang cha yod/ gsum mi dang dngos po'i dpya khral 'jal mi dgos pa dang zhib bsher mi byed/ bzhi gnas yul rgyal khab kyi mi sger gyi 'os 'gan ngal rtsol dang 'os 'gan zhal 'debs/ spyi tshogs nyen 'gog gi gtan 'bebs sogs bsgrub mi dgos pa bcas red/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyang rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs chen po zhig yin pas gong gsal gyi dmigs bsal dbang cha de dag rtsa 'dzugs der zhugs pa'i rgyal khab tshang mas mngags pa'i rgyun sdod gzhung tshab tshogs pa dang yang na rgyun sdod sku tshab tshogs pa mtha' dag la khyad med du dbang ba yin/ rang rgyal gyi rtsa khrims kyi don tshan re bdun pa dang don tshan gya gcig pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas par gzhigs na 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang ched bskos dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mo dang yang na rgyun sdod sku tshab de nges par 83

du rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gis bsko gzhag byed dgos pa dang / rgyal khab kyi kru'u zhis mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gis gtan 'bebs ltar mngags gtong byed dgos zhes bkod yod/brgyad pa/ krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa de/ krung go mi dmangs kyis hur brtson gyis dpal 'byor sa'i go la hril bo can la zhugs pa'i rnam pa gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la 'gran zla bral ba'i phan nus thob 'dug krung go rgyal khab la 'phel rgyas 'byung dgos na nges par du 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs dang kha 'bral mi rung / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab che shos krung go rgyal khab lta bu ma zhugs na cha tshang zhig kyang min/84

'on kyang krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim ni thogs thug med par bde blag ngang bgrod yong ba zhig ye nas min/ lo bco lnga'i ring la dka' ngal che ba'i gros mol sna tshogs brgyud nas zhugs pa zhig yin/ 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas su krung go lta bu'i rgyal khab chen po ma zhugs na mi chog krung go rgyal khab la dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'byung dgos na nges par du 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi khor yug chen po dang kha 'bral mi rung / krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa nas bzung 'dzam gling rgyal khab so sor sngar byung ma myong ba'i sgo mo cher phye ba'i tshong ra chen po zhig 'don sprod byed rgyu yin pas krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa de 'dzam gling dpal 'byor la mtshon na lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i don chen zhig yin pa gdon mi za'o/ /krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzus/sa kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab tu gyur pa nas bzung phyogs yongs nas 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi bya ba sna tshogs legs 85

por sgrub pa dang / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khe dbang sna tshogs longs su spyod pa'i khar 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig srol brtsi srung gang legs byas te 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khe dbang la lugs mthun gyi sgo nas longs spyod byed pa'i dus mtshungs su 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'os 'gan ma lus thams cad phrag 'khur dang len byas nas 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab gzhan pa dang mnyam du dge mtshan ldan zhing 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin gyi nus pa 'don bzhin yod/dgu ba/ krung go rgyal khab kyis 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang 'khur dgos pa'i 'os 'gan/'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'brel yod gros mthun chings yig ltar na tshong zog dang zhabs zhu/ shes rig thon dbang sogs kyi thad nas 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab gzhan dag la ches gzigs skyong rgyal khab kyi thob thang sprad dgos pa dang / tshong zog dang zhabs 86

zhu'i tshong ra'i sgo mo ches cher 'byed dgos pa yin/ don la sgo khral nyung 'phri dang sgo khral min pa'i bya thabs tshad ldan du gtong ba dang / rim gyis zhabs zhu'i nyo tshong gi sgo mo cher 'byed pa'i sgo nas gom gang mdun spos kyis shes rig thon dbang la srung skyob byed pa'i bya thabs tshad ldan du gtong ba dang / 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab gzhan dag bar drang gzhag ngang nyo tshong rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed pa las phyogs gang zhig gis kyang 'khon lan slog pa'i bya ba sgrub mi rung / nyo tshong srid jus dang 'brel yod khrims srol gyi kha gsal rang bzhin la shugs snon rgyag dgos shing / 'dzam gling thog tshong zog phyir gtong bsdur tshad gzhir bzung nas tshogs dngul dngos can zhig sprad dgos/krung go rgyal khab kyis 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang 'khur dgos pa'i 'os 'gan de bye brag tu brjod na 'di lta ste/ dang po ni 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs zhugs rgyal khab gzhan dag la ches gzigs skyong rgyal khab kyi thob thang dang rgyal dmangs thob thang sprad dgos/ gnyis pa ni sgo 87

khral nyung 'phri dang sgo khral min pa'i bkag cha sel ba/ 1990lo nas bzung krung go rgyal khab nas thengs mang por sgo khral mar phab/ krung go rgyal khab kyis khas blangs pa ltar cha snyoms kyis sgo khral10lnga)yas mas mar dbab rgyu/ sgo khral min pa'i thad nas rang rgyal gyis khral rigs3170lhag gi bkag cha med par gtong ba dang / nang 'dren bgo bya'i rigs400lhag bed spyad de tshong ra'i sgo 'byed la shugs snon dang grangs 'bor tshod 'dzin gyi shan shugs je chung la gtong ched nyo tshong gi bgo bya'i bcad 'bor lo rer15(7'phar snon byed kyin yod/gsum pa ni zhing las phyogs nas krung go rgyal khab dang a ri'i bar bzhag pa'i zhing las mnyam las kyi gros mthun chod yig ltar rang rgyal gyis khas blangs pa ni a ri'i byang rgyud dang nub rgyud kyi krig khul bdun 'a/sa thon pa'i gro rigs de zhi ya thu'u nas thad kur krung go rgyal khab la btsong rgyur 'thad pa dang / sgo khral mang po 'jal mi dgos pa'i zhing las thon rdzas nang 'dren sgos rgyal khab kyis nang 'dren byed par nyung 'phri dang dmangs gnyer sde khag gis nang 'dren 88

byed pa de je mang la gtong bar 'thad pa red/ tshong zog phyir gtong la gron dngul kha gsab med par gtong ba dang /nang sgos su a ri'i nyo tshong la gnod pa skyel ba'i ma rmos lo tog dang sring bal/ 'bras la sogs pa'i zhing las thon rdzas phyir btsong dus kha gsab med par gtong rgyu'i khas blangs/de min da dung sran ma dang sil tog chang rigs/ sha rigs/'o bzos thon rdzas sogs kyi sgo khral yang mar phab/ gzhan da dung a ri'i sha rigs las snon bzo ga6000lhag gi sha rigs thon rdzas nang 'dren byas nas rang rgyal gyi tshong ra nas btsong rgyur khas blangs/ bzhi ba ni dngul khang dang bde srung / yul skor/ glog 'phrin sogs kyi zhabs zhu'i las rigs kyi tshong ra'i bdag gnyer dbang cha rim gyis phyi phyogs la kha gtad pa/dper na krung go rgyal khab dang a ri gnyis ka nas gros mthun byung ba ltar krung go rgyal khab kyi phyogs nas lo lnga'i nang a ri'i dngul khang krung go'i tshong rar zhugs pa dang /krung go rgyal khab kyi tshong rar zhugs rjes phyi rgyal dngul khang gis krung go rgyal khab kyi khe las dang mi dmangs shog sgor gyi 89

phan tshun bar tshong don sogs bsgrub thub pa dang / krung go rgyal khab 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i lo drug gi nang phyi rgyal gyi ma dngul de glog 'phrin khyab khongs su bkol spyod byed par tshod 'dzin mi byed/ lnga ba ni krung go rgyal khab kyi nyo tshong srid jus dang srid gzhung gi do dam gyi kha gsal tshad mthor 'degs dang dus bcad ltar 'dzam gling nyo tshong rtsa 'dzugs kyis srid jus gdeng 'jog dang zhib gros la dang len byed pa'o/ /bcu ba/ dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab/'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab ces pa ni dpal 'byor cung rjes lus yin pa'i rgyal khab la zer ba dang /der 'phel rgyas byung med pa'i rgyal khab kyang zer/ spyir 'dzam gling gsum pa'i rgyal khab zer ba dang de'i nang gling chen a she ya dang / a hphe ri kha/ la ting me gling bcas kyi rgyal khab dang de min 'dzam gling sa khul130lhag tsam zhis tshud 90

yod/ dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab ces pa ni dpal 'byor mnyam las dang 'phel rgyas rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs gtogs rgyal khab yin/ rtsa 'dzugs der da yod khongs gtogs rgyal khab nyer dgu yod/ de'i nang nas a ri dang ljar pan/'jar man/ dbyin ji/ hpha ran se/ dbyi tha li/ kha na ta bcas rgyal khab ma gtogs rgyal khab gzhan dag dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab kyi tshad la bslebs med/ 'dzam gling dngul khang gis phul ba'i〈〈999lo dang2000lo'i 'dzam gling 'phel rgyas snyan zhu〉〉yi nang mi re'i cha snyomasatus2(rgyal dmangs thon skyed kyi spyi'i rin thang /)mtho dman la gzhigs nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab ni yong 'bab dma' ba'am yong 'bab 'bring tsam gyi rgyal khab kyi khongs su brtsis yod/dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab ni yong 'bab mtho ba'i rgyal khab la zer/ 'dzam gling dngul khang gi snyan zhu'i nang khyab bsgrags byas pa ltar na1998lor mi re'i cha snyoms6khoba.a sgor760man gyi rgyal khab ni yong 'bab dma' ba'i rgyal khab yin pa dang / mi re'i cha snyoms0kho2a sgor761nas9360yod 91

pa rnams ni yong 'bab 'bring ba'i rgyal khab yin/ mi re'i cha snyoms6kho2a sgor9361yan yod pa ni yong 'bab mtho ba'i rgyal khab yin/ der brten deng skabs dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab bar gyi khyad par ni mi re'i cha snyoms6kho2a sgo4360zin thub min de tshangs thig byas te dbye 'byed byas pa red/92

le'u gsum pa/ phyi rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong dang bslab bya/dang po/ phyi rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong /nga tshos shes gsal ltar sa khongs phan tshun 'phel rgyas byung tshul do mi mnyam pa'i gnad don de krung go rgyal khab ma gtogs rgyal khab gzhan dag la'ang yod de/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so dang nang sgos su nub phyogs dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab mang che ba zhig la mtshon na de 'dra'i gnas tshul byung myong / rgyal khab de dag gi rang byung cha rkyen dang dpal 'byor 'phel tshul/ spyi tshogs grub stangs/ rig gnas lo rgyus sogs kyi thad du khyad par che bar ma zad/ rgyal khab so sos lag len du bstar bzhin pa'i srid jus kyang sna tshogs pa zhig yin/ nga tshos gna' bzang deng spyod dang / snyigs dor 93

bcud len gyi byed thabs spyad de rgyal khab de dag gis dpal 'byor gsar spel dang nang sgos su rang rgyal khab kyi rjes lus sa khul gsar spel byas tshul der rgyus lon yag po byas na/rang re'i rong 'brog sa khul gyi dpal 'byor gsar spel de bde blag ngang 'grub par phan thogs chen po yod pa gdon mi za'o/ /gcig sa ri nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong /a ri srid gzhung gis dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu nas bzung rang gi nub rgyud sa khul gsar spel byed pa'i mgo brtsams shing / gsar spel gyi las dang po sa rgod slog pa de yin/ sa rgod slog pa'i las de ha larma/ dus rabs gnyis tsam gyi ring la spel bar brten a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul la 'gyur ldog chen po byung / nang sgos su tshan rtsal mtho rigs kyi thon las de dpal 'byor gyi rten gzhir gyur/a ris nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod du zhing las kyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded dang / zhor du 'grim 'grul 94

skyel 'dren las rigs dang grong khyer dang grong rdal 'dzugs pa/ bzo las 'phel rgyas su gtong ba/ rgyal khab nang logs su gcig gyur gyi tshong ra spel ba sogs la 'bad brtson lhod med byas pas/ nub rgyud gsar spel ni a ri'i lo rgyus steng nam yang sub thabs med pa'i rdo brkos ri mo lta bu zhig tu gyur/ dang thog gsar spel ma byas gong gi a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul ni sa rgya che zhing mi grangs nyung ba/ thon skyed nus shugs ha cang rjes lus yin pas ha lam gdod ma'i spyi tshogs skabs kyi rnam pa sor bzhag byas yod/ dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs lnga bcu ste a ri'i lho byang dmag 'khrug gi mjug tu a ri srid gzhung gis dpal 'byor gyi grub tshul snyoms sgrig dang / shar nub rgyud bar gyi khyad par je chung du gtong phyir/ nub skyod las 'gul rgya chen po zhig bslangs/gter rdzas sngog 'don pa dang phyugs 'tsho mkhan/ khe las pa/zhing pa/ shes yon can la sogs pa'i mi mang bo zhig la rgyal khab kyis 'bod skul btang ba dang nub rgyud sa khul gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i gter rdzas thon khungs dang mdzes sdug yid 95

du 'ongs pa'i spang ljongs/ mu mtha' bral ba'i sa zhing gshin po sogs kyis yid bkug par brten a ri rgyal yongs kyi mi grangs 'bor chen zhig phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas nub rgyud sa khul du gnas spor/ kho tshos lo mang bo'i ring la dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas pas 'khob yangs shing rgya che ba'i nub rgyud sa khul de a ri'i thon las kun la 'bru rigs dang bzo las rgyu cha mkho sprod byed pa'i rten gzhir gyur par ma zad/ sa khul gzhan nas bzos pa'i zhing phyugs bzo gsum gyi thon rdzas spel ba'i tshong ra med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur te a ri'i dpal 'byor mgyogs myur sgos 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar rmang gzhi brtan ngo/ zhig btings/ gal srid nub rgyud gsar spel chen po byas med rgyu na/ a ri ni ngeng skabs 'dzam gling thog ches sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal ldan pa'i rgyal khab kyi gras su tshud mi srid la ches phyug po yin pa'i rgyal khab tu'ang 'gyur mi thub/a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel de snga gzhug tu dus rim/ gsum brgyud pa yin/ dus rim dang ngo ni sa zhing gsar spel 96

gyi dus rim yin/ 1763lo nas bzung ste/a ri'i rang btsan dmag 'khrug nas dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i bar)a ri'i nub rgyud kyi dpal 'byor gsar spel gyi las 'gan gtso bo ni sa zhing gsar spel byed pa de yin/ a ri srid gzhung gis nub skyod las 'gul spel ba brgyud de nub rgyud sa khul du sger gyi zhing ra dang phyugs ra/ bzo grwa sogs mang po btsugs pa dang / zhing ra dang phyugs ra/ bzo grwa de dag gis a ri'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas dang deng rabs bzo las can gyi rgyal khab dang / dpal 'byor ches dar ba'i rgyal khab tu 'gyur ba'i rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan po zhis btings/ zhing las kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnad don ni sa zhing yin/ a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul du yangs shing rgya che ba'i sa rgod ha cang mod po yod na yang skabs der nub rgyud sa khul gyi sa zhing smo ra gyi sand don de a ri'i rgyal phran mnyam 'brel sri da sazhung gis thog ma/ra thag gcod bya dgos pa'i sand don du gyur/ rgyal phran ma nyam 'brel gyis a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul gyi sa zhing mtha' dag rgyal khab la dbang ba dang /97

rgyal khab la dbang ba'i sa zhing sger la btsong chog pa de yin/dus mtshungs su a ri srid gzhung gis ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis bton pa'i blang bya ltar sa zhing skor gyi khrims lugs te〈khang gzhi'i khrims lug༅zhes pa gtan khel byas nas bsgrags/ 〈khang gzhi'i khrims lug༅bsgrags pa des a ri'i lo rgyus thog thengs dang por sa zhing la rin pa mi len par bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i lam srol btod cing / a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul gyi sa zhing skor gyi gnad don che 'bring chung gsum thams cad mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi re 'dun ltar thag gcod byed pa'i lam lugs gsar ba btsugs/ a ri srid gzhung gis sa zhing gi srid jus rim gyis je dam du btang bas nub rgyud gsar spel gyi gom 'gros je mgyogs su gtong bar mthun rkyen yag po bzos/ nang sgos su zhing pa rnams la phyogs gang thad nas stabs bde bzos pas rmo 'debs kyi las la brtson pa'i blo stobs chen po skyed/ nub rgyud gsar spel dang sbrags a ri'i zhing las la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas dang zhing pa'i sa zhing gi gnad don sngar las kyang 98

thag gcod yag po byas par brten/ mi grangs ha cang mang bo zhig a ri'i nub rgyud kyi mu'u zhi zhi pa'e gtsang bo'i nub phyogs kyi yangs shing rgya che ba'i yul ljongs la gnas spor nas zhing phyugs bzo gsum gyi las gnyer bas 'phel rgyas ha cang chen po byung / dang thog a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel byed dus sa zhing dang 'brel ba ha cang dam po yod/ a ri'i nub rgyud sa zhing gis a ri'i spyi'i sa zhing ta705—805zin/ a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel chen por mtshon na sa zhing gis gzhan gyis tshab byed mi rung ba'i nus pa chen po thon 'dugadaper na zhing phyugs bzo gsum dang nags las/ gter las/ chu bed/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren/ mkhar grong chags pa sogs las rigs mtha' dag sa zhing la brten nas grub cing 'phel ba yin pas/ skabs der a ris nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i thabs shes gtso bo ni/ srid gzhung gis sa zhing tshong ra nas nyo tshong byed pa dang gcig khe las che 'bring chung gsum kun nub rgyud gsar spel gyi las la zhugs par rting skul byed par srid gzhung gis sa zhing bya dgar gnang ba dang 99

gnyis/ nub rgyud sa khul du gnas spor ba'i mi rnams kyis rang mos kyis sa zhing bdag dbang dang tshong gnyer byas pas der srid gzhung gis khas blangs pa dang gsum mo//'o na a ris nub rgyud gsar spel la grub 'bras bzang po zhig blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de mthar gtugs na a ri srid gzhung gis nub rgyud sa khul gyi sa gnas yu la bab kyi gnas tshul dang / srid 'byor rig gsum gyi 'phel phyogs/ a ri mi dmangs rnams kyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i srid jus gtan khel byas pa de yin/ dper na a ris nub rgyud gsar spel la zhugs pa'i khe las dang mi sger la rin pa mi len par sa zhing sbyin pa dang / gron dngul kha gsab gtong ba sogs kyi srid jus lag bstar byas rjes a ri'i 'grim 'grul las rigs kyi 'phel rgyas la 'bras bu chen po thob/ 1823lo nas bzung a ri'i rgyal phran mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gis gzhung lam dang mis bzos gtsang bo/lcags lam sogs bzo skrun byed pa'i ched du sa zhing 'bor chen rin pa ma blangs par sbyin pas nub rgyud sa khu' gyi 100

'grim 'grul las rigs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung / dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus mjug tu a ri nas a ri byang ma'i skam sa'i shar nub brgyud pa/'i lcags lam chen po gsum bzos shing lcags lam de gsum po'i spyi'i ring tshad la dbyin le khri tsho sum cu lhag yod pa de skabs de'i 'dzam gling gi lcags lam spyi'i ring tshad las kyang da dung ring / a ri'i rgyal yongs kyi 'grim 'grul dra ba tshugs par brten shar rgyud dang nub rgyud bar gyi mnyam 'brel sngar las dam po dang /rgyal yongs gcig 'gyur gyi tshong ra grub par skul 'ded byas/dus rim/ gnyis pa ni bzo las gsar spel gyi dus rim yin/ nang 'khrug langs pa'i rjes su a ri'i spyi tshogs dang srid 'byor rig gsum la 'gyur ldog chen po byung / ches/ ma/ngon gsal gyi mtshon rtags thig ni grong gseb dang zhing las gtso gnyer byed pa'i rgyal khab nas bzo las gtso gnyer byed pa'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur/ dus rim de ha lar/ dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs lnga bcu nas dus rabs nyi shu ba'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen ang gnyis pa mjug rdzogs pa'i 101

snga phyi bar yin/ dus rim der dmigs bsal gyi mtshon rtags gnyis yod de/ gcig ni1849lor li hphu nye yā nas gser gyi gter kha gsar du rnyed par brten gter las dar ba'i rnam pa gsar ba zhig byung ba dang / gnyis ni nub rgyud dang nang sgos su nub rgyud dbus ma dang / rgyang ring nub rgyud sa khul bcas su grong khyer dang grong rdal mang po chags/dus rim de'i skabs su a ri'i bzo las kyi rten gzhi shar rgyud dang byang rgyud nas rim gyis nub rgyud dbus ma'i sa khul la spor bar ma zad/ nub rgyud dbus ma'i sa khul du bzo las che 'bring chung gsum gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig chags pas/ phyis su a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul de bzo las ha cang dar ba'i gnas su gyur pa dang mnyam du nub rgyud sa khul du zhing las 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rnam pa gsar ba'i lam btod/ dus rim de'i gsar spel la brten nas a ri'i dpal 'byor khyon yongs nas dar zhing rgyas pa dang 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi rgyal khab chen po dang stobs 'byor ldan pa'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur/ gzhan yang a ri'i rta nor lug 102

gsum gtso byas pa'i phyugs las gnyer ba sogs las rigs mtha' dag nub rgyud gsar spel gyi mthun rkyen 'og rmang gzhi brtan po tshugs shing 'phel rgyas gang legs byung / sa gnas kyi cha nas bshad na/ a ri'i bzo las can du gyur pa'i 'phel rim ni mi ser spel ba'i dus skabs su chags pa'i shar rgyud dang byang rgyud kyi bzo las khul rnying ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng 'phel rgyas byung ba nas rim gyis nub rgyud sa khul la bkram/gsal bor bshad na/ dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs drug cu'i sngon la bzo skrun las rigs mang che shos a ri'i shar rgyud du gnas yod/ 'on kyang lo rabs drug cu ba'i mjug tu a ri'i bzo skrun las rigs kyi rten gzhi nub rgyud sa khul la spor/ de ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rang mos 'gran rtsod kyi shugs rkyen dang tshong ra'i nang rkyen gyi nus pa zung 'brel las thon pa'i 'bras bu zhig red/ a ri'i bzo las 'phel rim nang mngon gsal gyi khyad chos shig yod pa ni ngal rtsol nus shugs dkon pa/ ngal rtsol nus shugs dkon pa'i gnad don thag gcod gang legs byed pa'i ched du a ri'i 103

las rigs so sos bzo las lag rtsal la gsar brje las 'gul spel ba dang / tshang mas rang rang gi las risas kyi khyad chos la bstun te de dang 'tsham pa'i ches sngon thon gyi 'phrul chas dang 'phrul 'khor bzos shing lag cha gsar ba dang lag rtsal gsar ba bkol spyod byas te ci thub gang nus kyis ngal rtsol las chod mthor 'degs byed pa dang ngal rtsol dus tshod gron chung byas nas ngal rtsol nus shugs dkon pa'i gnad don de thag gcod yag po byas/dus rim gsum pa ni tshan rig lag rtsal gsar spel byas pa de yin/ a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel gyi nang du tshan rig lag rtsal gyis nus pa gal chen bton yod/ a ri'i nub rgyud sa khul du sa rin dma' zhing thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/gnam gshis dro zhing sa zhing gi 'khob yangs pa ngal rtsol nus shugs kyi gla yon mthon po min pa bcas kyis mtho gsar lag rtsal gyi bzo las 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur mthun rkyen yag po bskrun/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su nub rgyud dang lho rgyud kyis a ri'i dmag don bzo las 'bor chen 104

dmangs spyod la bsgyur ba'i go skabs dam 'dzin byas te mkha' skyod dang rdul phran nus pa/ glog rdul la so gas pa'i tshan rtsal mtho rigs kyi thon las mgyogs myur sgos 'phel rgyas su btang yod/ dper na cwa li hphu nyi yā krig khul gyi ku'e rigs ngar lcags 'don sa'i lung gzhung dang / pa'e khā 'o la'e nā krig khul gyi zur gsum zhib 'jug khul/ yā the lan ta'i rtsis rgyag 'phrul chas bzo las khul la sogs pa ni a ri nas skad grags che ba'i mtho gsar tshan rtsal bzo las zhib 'jug dang thon skyed bya yul yod tshad nub rgyud dang lho rgyud na yod/ a ri'i rgyal tshogs lag rtsal gdeng 'jog cus bsdoms rtsis ltar na1972lo nas1977lo bar lag rtsal mtho rigs bzo las nang las kur zhugs mkhan ches mang ba'i grong khyer chen po bcu yod pa'i nang gi grong khyer gnyis byang shar rgyud kyi mā sa kru'u sa'e krig khul du yod pa phud gzhan mtha' dag nub rgyud sa khul du yod zer/ ke lan te ho rig gzhung zhib 'jug/ khyams ra zhes pa ni tshan rtsal mtho rigs a ri'i nub rgyud du mkho spyod byas pa'i ma dpe yin/ dus rabs 105

nyi shu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i dus mgor a ri srid gzhung gis mo zhi kho krig khul gsar ba'i lo si a la mo ser ma dngul btang nas rgyal khab kyi rdul phran rten gzhi btsugs/de'i rjes su si khe lu sa'e si'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i mo zhi kho krig khul gsar bas btsugs pa'i slob grwa chen mo'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi byed sgo spel nas gong gsal sa gnas de gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i ke lan te ho rig gzhung zhib 'jug khyams ra grub/ rig gzhung khyams ra de'i lte bar gnas pa'i ar po khe ci grong khyer gyis lag rtsal mtho rigs zhib 'jug byed pa'i sang ti yā rgyal khab rim pa'i tshod lta khang btsugs/ tshan rtsal zhib 'jug dang gsar spel byas par brten sa khul de'i dpal 'byor la sngar yod ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi lam gsar ba zhig btod/ a ri'i dpal 'byor gyi lte gnas de nub rgyud la spor ba dang sbrags rgyun spyod kha par gyi glog rdul kung si la sogs pa'i skad grags che ba'i lag rtsal mtho rigs kung si khag cig gis de gar gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bzo grwa btsugs pa dang 'brel zhib 'jug gsar spel dang thon 106

skyed kyi gnas gzhi btsugs/ ar po khe ci grong khyer gyi mi grangs kyang1940lo'i khri tsho3 5nas1990lo'i khri 138 5bar 'phar yod cing / sngon chad bal dang so phag sogs thon rdzas dma' rim de 'dra btsongs nas 'tsho thabs byed bzhin pa'i grong rdal chung chung de lag rtsal mtho rigs kyi thon rdzas thon skyed dang tshong ra phyi nang la tshong byed pa'i grong khyer phyug po zhig tu gyur/tshan rig lag rtsal ni a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel la skul 'ded byed pa'i nus shugs gal chen zhig yin / a ris nub rgyud kyi zhing las gsar spel byed pa'i khrod du zhing las 'phrul chas can du bsgyur ba dang tshan rig can du bsgyur ba/de min da dung tshan rig dang mthun pa'i zhing 'debs thabs khyab spel byed pa ni zhing las thon skyed nus shugs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i thabs shes gal chen zhig red/nub rgyud sa khul du zhing las gsar spel byas par brten a ri'i nub rgyud kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rmang gzhi btings pa bden mod/ 'on kyang a ri'i nub rgyud kyi 107

'phel rgyas tshad mthon po zhig la slebs pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni bzo las dar ba de red/ bzo las dar ba de yang tshan rig lag rtsal gyis ram 'degs la rag las pa'o//'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su a ri'i nub rgyud kyi dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i brgyud rim nang tshan rig lag rtsal thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin pa'i khyad chos lhang nger mtshon 'dug a ris nub rgyud gsar spel lo brgya lhag tsam la byas par grub 'bras chen po thob yod pa de dag tshang ma a ris nub rgyud sa khul gyi rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod la ma dngul chen po btang ba dang kha 'bral thabs med/ma dngul de dag gi yong khungs gtso bo ni rgyal phran mnyam 'brel srid gzhung dang sa gnas srid gzhung / kung si dang khe las bcas yin pa las gzhan da dung phyi phyogs kyi ma dngul yang nyung tsam bsdu len byas yod/ ma dngul 'jog stangs de rigs spyi phan ma dngul 'jog stangs kyi ngo bo dang 'dra bas rgyal khab kyis ma dngul chen po btang nas rogs skyor byas shing / rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi gar stegs yag po zhig 108

brgyab pa dang 'brel thag yag po zhig 'then pa'i rkyen gyis phyi phyogs kyi ma dngul 'jog mkhan khe las dang mi sger la spro ba chen po bskyed pa dang / khe las rang nyid la'ang rang gi nus pa 'don yul gsar ba zhig rnyed byung / a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel byed rim nang rgyal phran mnyam 'brel srid gzhung nas nor srid kyi kha gsab dang spo sgyur gtong sprod la shugs snon rgyag pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas par ma zad/ da dung krig khul dang rdzong sogs kyi sa gnas srid gzhung so sor bab bstun gyi rang bdag dbang cha yod pas khe las mang po bkug nas a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel la dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan po zhig btings/a ri ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab cig yin pas de'i dpal 'byor gyi gzhi rtsa'i lam lugs ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi'i thog tu btsugs yod pa dang / tshong ra'i rin thang chos nyid la gzhigs te dpal 'byor gyi bya 'gul ci rigs spel/ a ri srid gzhung gis nub rgyud gsar spel skor la cha tshang zhing yun ring ba'i 'char gzhi rab dang rim pa 109

bkod cing / a ri'i nub rgyud gyi dpal 'byor gsar spel de ni rang mos dang sgo 'byed/ ma dngul 'jog stangs sna tshogs pa dang skabs 'tshol rang bzhin ldan pa bcas kyi brgyud rim zhig yin/ a ri srid gzhung gis krung dbyang rgyal phran mnyam 'brel dang krig khul srid gzhung gi dbang cha so so byas nas rim pa gnyis can gyi dbang cha'i lam lugs lag bstar byas shing / rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyi gtso 'gan ni phyi 'brel dang mtha' mtshams bde srung sogs yin/ krig khul gyi gtso 'gan ni slob gso dang dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i las don sgrub pa de yin/ a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel gyi brgyud rim khrod du krig khul dang sa gnas srid gzhung gis rang mos dang rang 'gul/ sgo 'byed kyi 'du shes dang rnam par brten nas blo rig dang nus shugs/ brtson sems sogs gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas 'don spel byas yod/gong gsal de dag ni a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel la grub 'bras bzang po thob pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/ a ri'i rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyis rtsa khrims dang khrims lugs 110

gzhir bzung ste nub rgyud gsar spel la rang mos dang drang gzhag 'gran rtsod sogs kyi khor yug yag po zhig bzos par ma zad/ spyi'i sa zhing dang dngul khang / ma dngul bsdu gsog la sogs par rgyal khab srid jus kyi cha nas rogs skyor ci thub byas/ gal srid srid gzhung gis khrims lugs dang srid jus/ zhib tshags ldan pa'i do dam sogs byas med na/a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel la grub 'bras de 'dra chen po zhig thob dka'/ yang dang thog rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyis nub rgyud gsar spel nang du bton pa'i nus shugs la gzhigs na/ srid gzhung gis dpal 'byor la nges par du the gtogs bya dgos mod/ 'on kyang gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas gang la gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas the gtogs bya dgos/gal srid the gtogs byed drags na dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la phan thogs pa phar zhog gnod pa skyel nges yin/ der brten nub rgyud gsar spel gyi bya rim nang du khe las kyi hur brtson rang bzhin dang gsar gtod rang bzhin 'don spel gang legs byas te srid gzhung gis gtan khel byas pa'i 111

khrims lugs kyi khyab khongs nang du 'khor skyod byed du 'jug dgos/ srid gzhung gis spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang khe las sogs la the gtogs byed pa'i tshad gzhi ni drang gzhag dang phan 'bras do mnyam yong ba de yin/ gzhan yang sa gnas de'i yul bab dang thon khungs/ srid 'byor rig gsum gyi gnas tshul dngos la gzhigs te gsar spel bya dgos/ a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel gyi thog ma'i dus skabs su gsar spel gyi thabs lam 'tshol ba'i bya 'gul kho na zhig yin stabs/gsar spel mkhan gyis rang byung khor yug gi mthun rkyen dang rang steng du 'dzoms pa'i thon skyed lag rtsal gyi byang tshad la gzhigs te rang mos rang 'thad kyi sgo nas gsar spel gyi thon las bdams pa red/ yul bab dang sa gshis/ gnam zla sogs kyi cha rkyen mi gcig pas gsar spel byed pa'i thabs lam dang brgyud rim yang mi gcig dper na mu'u zhi zhi pa'e gtsang bo'i 'bab rgyud kyi gsar spel de zhing las gter sngogashebazo las kyi lam la bgrod pa dang / rgyang ring nub rgyud kyi gsar spel ni gter sngogargezhing las bzo las kyi lam la 112

bgrod cing nub rgyud bde thang chen mo nas phyugs las zhing las bzo las kyi lam du bgrod/ sa gnas de dag gis gsar spel byed pa'i thabs shes dang bgrod lam mi gcig kyang tshang mar grub 'bras chen po thob/ de las nga tshos gsal bor shes thub pa ni rang byung gi cha rkyen dang thon khungs kyi cha rkyen/ tshong ra'i cha rkyen sogs la gzhigs te gsar spel gyi thon las bdams pa ni a ri'i nub rgyud gsar spel la grub 'bras chen po thob pa'i rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig yin/gnyis/ ljar pan nas pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong /ljar pan ni da lta 'dzam gling steng du dpal 'byor ches dar ba'i rgyal khab cig yin mod/ 'on kyang sa gnas phan tshun bar dpal 'byor 'phel tshul do ma mnyam pa'i lo rgyus ljar pan la'ang byung myong / dang thog gsar spel ma byas gong gi ljar pan gyi ches byang rgyud kyi pa'e ha'e ta'o sa khul bcas kyi dpal 'byor 'phel tshul la khyad par ha cang che bas/ ljar pan srid gzhung gis skabs der ha cang rjes lus yin pa'i 113

pa'e ha'e ta'o sa khul la gsar spel byed pa'i mgo brtsams/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i mjug tu ljar pan rgyal khab kyis dpal 'byor nyams gso byed pa'i khur bo ha cang lci mo zhig 'khur dasos byung / 'bru rigs dang nus khungs/shing cha sogs ha cang dkon pa dang rgyal khab la phyir log pa'i dmag mi dang las gnyer pa sa ya lhag gi bkod sgrig dang las zhugs gnad don de dag rtsa ba nas thag gcod byed pa'i ched du ljar pan srid gzhung gis pa'e ha'e ta'o sa khul du mi grangs nyung zhing sa zhing mod pa'i mthun rkyen bed spyod gang legs byas te rgyal yongs kyi dpal 'byor nyams gso la thon khungs gsar ba 'don sprod byed pa'i sems thag bcad/der brten ljar pan srid gzhung gis da dung dmigs bsal du〈pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel gyi khrims lug༅zhes pa gtan khel byas nas pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel la grub 'bras bzang bo 'thob pa'i rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan po zhig btings/ pa'i ha'e ta'o gsar spel la krung dbyang dang sa gnas gnyis yis 'gan 'khur ba'i lam lugs btod cing / krung dbyang gis 114

gsar spel las tshan chen po'i 'gan 'khur ba dang / pa'e ha'e ta'o sa gnas srid gzhung gis ram 'degs rang bzhin gyi gsar spel rnam grangs 'gan khur yod/ pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel bīn gyis ljar pan srid gzhung gi tshab byas te sde khag so so'i bar gyi 'char gzhi bkod sgrig la mthun sbyor byed pa'i 'gan khur bas las rigs so so'i bar don med rtsod gleng dang las 'gan gyi dbye mtshams gsal bo min pa'i gnad don dang 'gal zla 'byung bar bkag 'gog byas/ljar pan srid gzhung gis pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel khrin gyis snga gzhug tu dus rim pa drug gi gsar spel 'char gzhi bkod cing dus rim so sor yang gsar spel byed pa'i bye brag gi gtso gnad gtan phab byas yod/ dus rim dang po'i gsar spel 'char gzhi ni1952nas1962lo'i bar yin/ sngar gyi lo lnga'i nang gtso bo nus khungs gsar spel dang 'bru rigs thon skyed byed pa de yin/ mjug gi lo lnga'i nang gtso bo thon las dar spel dang zhing las thon skyed kyi rmang gzhi 'dzugs rgyur shugs snon rgyag pa dang / zhing chu nags gsum gyi thon 115

las thon skyed kyi las chod mthor 'degs byed pa de yin/dus rim gnyis pa'i gsar spel 'char gzhi ni1963nas1970lo'i bar yin la/ gsar spel gyi dmigs bya gtso bo ni thon las grub tshul snyoms sgrig dang deng rabs can du bsgyur ba/'grim 'grul dang 'phrin skyel/ nus khungs/ skyel 'dren bcas kyi ma lag cha tshang 'dzugs rgyu/ de min da dung rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs hril bo'i bde srung dang chu bed thon khungs gsar spel byed pa de yin/ dus rim gsum pa'i 'char gzhi ni1971nas1977lo'i bar yin la/ gsar spel bya yul gtso bo ni ngal rtsol thon skyed nus shugs mthor 'angegs dang phan khe che ba'i spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang 'grim 'grul/'phrin skyel/ nus khungs/ skyel 'dren gyi ma lag gsar ba 'dzugs pa de yin/ dus rim bzhi ba'i 'char gzhi ni1978nas1987lo'i bar yin/ dus rim de'i gsar spel gyi dmigs bya gtso bo ni rkang 'dzin thon las kyi 'thus sgo je tshang dang rmang gzhi je brtan du gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi gtan 'jags dang rgyal khab nang logs kyi 116

khor yug phyogs yongs nas yag por gtong ba de yin/ dus rim lnga ba'i 'char gzhi de1988nas1997lo'i bar sgrub pa dang /dmigs yul gtso bo ni gson nyams ldan zhing mnyen pa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i thon las 'dus tshogs shig 'dzugs pa dang / chu tshad mtho ba'i 'grim 'grul dang brda 'phrin 'phrin skyel gyi dra ba gsar du bzo skrun byed pa dang / pa'e ha'e ta'o dpal 'byor de rgyal yongs dang tha na 'dzam gling tshong ra'i nang 'gran rtsod kyi nus shugs chen po ldan pa'i sa khongs rang bzhin gyi dpal 'byor du bsgyur te ljar pan gyi yun ring 'phel rgyas la byas rjes 'jog pa'o/ /dus rim drug pa'i gsar spel 'char gzhi ni1998lo nas2001lo'i bar yin/ de ni mig sngar lag len du bstar ba'i sgang yin la/ gsar spel gyi dmigs yul ni mdzes sdug yid du 'ongs pa'i pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar ba zhig 'dzugs skrun byed pa de yin/ gtso bo pa'e ha'e ta'o de 'dzugs skrun byas nas ljar pan gyi zas rigs thon rdzas kyi thon skyed dang las snon rgyag pa'i rten gzhi/ mtho gsar lag rtsal dang brda 'phrin 'phrin skyel sogs kyi ra ba/117

rgyal dmangs yul skor spro bsang dang ngal gso rol rtsed/lab gleng sogs byed pa'i kun dga'i gling ka zhig tu bsgyur ba de yin/ ljar pan srid gzhung gis 'char gzhi de dag bde blag ngang lag bstar byed pa'i ched du pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel la ma dngul 'bor chen btang / dus rim dang po'i gsar spel 'char gzhi lag bstar byed pa'i skabs su gsar spel ma dngul ljar pan sgor mo dung phyur193 btang ba dang /dus rim gnyis pa'i snga gzhug tu bsdoms pas ma dngul ljar pan sgor mo dung phyur khri tsho19 7504/btang / nye char lo 'ga'i ring la ljar pan gyi dpal 'byor la nyams gud byung ba dang /bu lon gyi 'obs su lhung zhing srid gzhung gi nor srid la dka' khag chen po byung yod na'ang pa'i ha'e ta'o sasar spel byed pa'i thad du spyod pa'i ma dngul nyung 'phri nyag tsam yang btang med par ma zad/ da dung lo re bzhin 'phar snon rgyag gi yod/ dus rim so so'i thon las skyed sring dang gsar spel gyi gom 'gros je mgyogs su gtong ched ljar pan srid gzhung gis da dung pa'e ha'e ta'o nas thon las gsar spel byed pa'i 118

dmangs khrod khe las la ma dngul btang nas rogs skyor byas/1999lor ljar pan srid gzhung gi ma dngul las khungs kyis pa'e ha'e ta'o gsar spel la 'don sprod byas pa'i ma dngul bsdoms pas ljar pan sgor mo dung phyur khri tsho14 75lhag yin/ljar pan rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis lo mang bo'i ring 'bad brtson lhod med sgos gsar spel byas par brten mi med lung stong gi gling phran de bzo zhing phyugs gsum dang sa chu nags gsum 'dzoms pa/ brda 'phrin 'phrin skyel dang 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren/ mtho gsar lag rtsal la zhib 'jug dang gsar spel sogs thon las kyi sna mang zhing 'thus sgo tshang ba/ dpal 'byor ha cang dar ba'i sa khul du gyur te ljar pan gyi bzo zhing phyugs gsum sogs las rigs kun la mkho ba'i 'phrul 'khor 'phrul chas rgyun ma chad par 'don sprod byed pa'i rten gzhi dang rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo spel bar med du mi rung ba'i thon khungs shig tu gyur/ 'gran zla med pa'i byang rgyud kyi yul ljongs la gnas skor spro bsang dang der 'brel ba'i thon las ni pa'e ha'e ta'o sa khul gyi dpal 'byor 119

spel ba'i ka rten lta bu yin/ 1997lo'i zla bzhi ba nas1998lo'i zla sa/sum pa'i bar ljar pan rgyal yongs kyi thon skyed rin thang bsdoms pas ljar pan sgor mo dung phyur khri 1500 3yin/de'i nang du pa'e ha'e ta'o sa khul gyi thon skyed rin thang bsdoms pas ljar pan sgor mo dung phyur khri tsho20 3yin/ ha lam me sgor dung phyu4000yin/ mi re cha snyoms kyis thon skyed rin thang bsdoms pas rgyal yongs cha snyoms chu tshad la slebs yod/gsum/ hin rdu rgyal khab nas dpal 'byor gsar spel byas pa las thob pa'i nyams myong /hin rdu rgyal khab kyis rang gi rjes lus sa khul gsar spel byas pa de gtso bo hin rdu srid gzhung bis hin rdu'i ༅ra byang rgyud kyi mtha' mtshams sa khul shugs chen pos gsar spel byas/ hin rdu shar byang mtha' mtshams sa khul de rang rgyal bod yul gyi rong 'brog sa khul dang bsdur na sa bab dang mi grangs/ grangs nyung mi rigs mang ba sogs kyi gnas tshul phal cher 'dra/ hin rdu mtha' mtshams sa khul gyi ri klong 120

rgyas byung thub pa'i khe las gcig kyang med/ lag len las bden dpang thub pa ltar/ rjes lus sa khul gang zhig la gsar spel byed dus gzhan gyi rogs skyor dang gzigs skyong srid jus la brten los dgos/ 'on te de dag kho nar rag las byed pa las sa gnas rang gi 'phel shugs la mthong chung byas na sa gnas de ga'i 'phel yun mi ring kho thag yin/gsum/ srol rgyun rig gnas la mthong chung byas/phyi rgyal gyis 'phel rgyas byung med pa'i sa khul gsar spel byas tshul la gzhigs na rgyal khab so sos rjes lus sa khul gyi thon khungs dang skye khams khor yug dpal 'byor ma dngul sogs kyi khor yug yag po yin min la bltas te gsar spel rnam grangs 'dam bkod byas pa yin mod/ 'on kyang gsar spel byed dus rjes lus sa khul gyi srol rgyun rig gnas la srung skyob byed ma thub pas mi rigs kyi yul srol goms 'dris dang chos lugs/ rig rtsal sogs 'dus pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas la gtor rlag tshabs chen phog sa ris nub rgyud gsar spel dang u ru sus zhi pa'o li ya gsar spel skabs su 139
